items.title: 受美債拋售潮衝擊 10年期日債殖利率飆升10.5個基點至2.795%
items.title_en: 10-Year Japanese Bond Yield Surges 10.5 Basis Points to 2.795% Amid U.S. Treasury Sell‑Off
paras: 受美國最新通膨數據高於預期影響，美聯準會(Fed)官員相繼釋出更為鷹派的升息訊號，促使美債爆發強烈拋售潮。美國 2 年期公債殖利率劇增 18 個基點至 4.74%，創下近期最大單日漲幅，10 年期美債殖利率再次衝破 5% 大關。
這股賣壓隨即波及日本債券市場。11 日日本公債價格顯著走低、殖利率普遍飆升，其中指標性 10 年期日本公債殖利率大漲 10.5 個基點，來到 2.795%；5 年期公債殖利率上揚 9.5 個基點至 2.195%；對政策利率極為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率亦攀升 8.5 個基點至 1.86%。
隨著賣壓湧現，金融市場交換合約顯示，投資人對日本央行 12 月升息的預期機率已大幅回升至約 85%。
巴克萊證券外匯與利率策略主管門田真一郎分析，先前日債殖利率的回落屬於市場過度反應，當前走揚反映出對先前跌幅的合理修正，預計未來殖利率仍有進一步向上回升的空間。
paras_en: The latest U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, prompting Federal Reserve officials to signal a more hawkish stance on rate hikes. This sparked a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries, with the 2‑year Treasury yield soaring 18 basis points to 4.74%, the biggest single‑day rise in recent weeks, and the 10‑year yield breaking above the 5% threshold again.

The selling pressure quickly spilled over into Japan’s bond market. On the 11th, Japanese government bond prices fell markedly and yields rose across the board, with the benchmark 10‑year JGB yield jumping 10.5 basis points to 2.795%; the 5‑year yield climbing 9.5 basis points to 2.195%; and the policy‑rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield also rising 8.5 basis points to 1.86%.
As the sell‑off intensified, futures contracts in the financial markets showed that investors’ probability of a Bank of Japan rate hike in December surged to roughly 85%.

Shinichiro Kadota, head of FX and rates strategy at Barclays Securities, said the earlier decline in Japanese yields was an over‑reaction by the market. The current rally reflects a reasonable correction of the prior drop, and he expects further upside potential for yields moving forward.

items.title: 6美元就能癱瘓美軍基地和法國超市！KPMG揪企業3大「受駭」漏洞
items.title_en: $6 Can Paralyze a US Military Base and French Supermarkets! KPMG Identifies Three Major Corporate "Hackable" Vulnerabilities
paras: 近期法國連鎖超市冷凍櫃遭駭客遠端操控升溫導致食品全報廢，連區域血液庫與美軍基地也傳類似災情，且駭客僅耗費28分鐘與6美元便能癱瘓這些系統。這類新型態網路攻擊不為竊取資料或勒索贖金，而是直接破壞民生物資與社會運作。KPMG專家示警，隨著AI技術降低駭客門檻，資安危機已從傳統基礎設施蔓延至民生供應鏈與企業營運場址。台灣公私部門與民眾應立即檢視聯網設備防護機制，防範遠端操控帶來的實體破壞風險，強化關鍵民生服務韌性。
KPMG亞太區政府領域資安主持人邱述琛表示，這是全球首見衝擊民生物資供應鏈的大型網路攻擊。駭客讓超市冷櫃變質清空，企圖透過媒體效應引發社會恐慌。冷藏設備廣泛應用於生鮮運輸、醫療疫苗保存及高科技產業，若遭破壞風險極高。
由於近期案例顯示攻擊目標已轉向民生服務。邱述琛指出，駭客僅是找到未上鎖的系統入口，更有研究機構利用AI工具，僅耗費28分鐘與6美元便重現攻擊，顯示犯罪門檻已大幅降低。
針對企業防護盲點，KPMG安侯企業管理副總經理洪慧茹點出三大高風險系統特性，呼籲國內組織儘速補強。
首先是設備具備遠距維護功能，許多現場維修設備新增遠端連線卻未納入資安管理。建議將所有連線設備納入盤點，限制對外連線並採多因子認證強化控管。
其次是存在弱密碼或預設密碼，部分舊型設備風險尤高，應立即清查並導入定期更換機制，無法改善的老舊設備則必須實體隔離或直接汰換。
洪慧茹進一步說明，第三個高風險特性為正常功能遭惡意操作。冷藏櫃除霜或升溫等原本正常運作的功能，一旦遭駭客入侵就可能被反向利用，直接造成龐大營運與財物損失。她建議企業必須針對溫度與時間等關鍵參數，設定安全上限與異常告警系統，必要時加入人工確認及自動中止機制。從系統面著手防範，才能避免駭客透過合法功能掩護非法破壞，確保企業營運場址的實體設備不會成為網路攻擊受災戶。
過去民眾與企業多半關注水電與金融等傳統關鍵基礎設施，此次國外冷鏈遭駭案例實證此類攻擊對社會影響甚鉅。邱述琛提醒，一般民眾家中的智慧電視與聯網冰箱等設備，同樣存在被入侵監控的疑慮。
更重要的是，邱述琛強調未來政府規劃提高資安防護與服務韌性時，應將民生供應鏈納入考量。企業與社會大眾都應儘速檢視物聯網設備的資安現況、生命週期及委外管理機制，全面防堵AI時代下無孔不入的新型態網路威脅。
paras_en: Recently, a French supermarket chain's freezers were remotely manipulated by hackers to raise temperatures, causing all food to spoil. Similar incidents were reported at a regional blood bank and a US military base, with the attackers needing only 28 minutes and $6 to cripple these systems. This new type of cyberattack is not aimed at data theft or ransom, but at directly destroying essential goods and disrupting societal functions. KPMG experts warn that as AI lowers the barrier for hackers, cybersecurity threats have spread from traditional infrastructure to everyday supply chains and corporate operations. Taiwan's public and private sectors, as well as the general public, should immediately review the protection mechanisms of networked devices to guard against physical damage from remote control and strengthen the resilience of critical civilian services.

KPMG Asia‑Pacific government‑sector cybersecurity lead Chiu Shu‑chen said this is the first globally observed large‑scale cyberattack that hits the civilian goods supply chain. Hackers caused supermarket freezers to spoil and empty, aiming to spark social panic through media coverage. Refrigeration equipment is widely used in fresh‑food transport, medical vaccine storage, and high‑tech industries, and its destruction would pose extremely high risks.

Recent cases show that attack targets have shifted toward civilian services. Chiu noted that hackers simply found an unsecured system entry point, and research institutions using AI tools were able to replicate the attack in just 28 minutes and $6, demonstrating that the crime barrier has dropped dramatically.

Addressing corporate protection blind spots, KPMG senior manager of enterprise risk management Hong Hui‑ru highlighted three high‑risk system characteristics and urged domestic organizations to reinforce them promptly.

First, many devices now have remote‑maintenance capabilities, yet numerous on‑site repair tools have added remote connections without proper cybersecurity controls. She recommends inventorying all connected devices, restricting external connections, and enforcing multi‑factor authentication for stronger governance.

Second, weak or default passwords persist, especially on older equipment, which carries heightened risk. Immediate password audits and regular rotation mechanisms are needed, and equipment that cannot be secured should be physically isolated or replaced entirely.

Third, normal functions can be maliciously manipulated. Features such as defrosting or temperature increase, which are legitimate operations, can be hijacked by attackers to cause massive operational and financial losses. Hong advises companies to set safety thresholds and anomaly alerts for critical parameters like temperature and time, and to add manual verification and automatic shutdown mechanisms when necessary. By defending from the system level, organizations can prevent hackers from using legitimate functions as a cover for illegal destruction and ensure physical assets at operational sites are not victims of cyber attacks.

Historically, the public and businesses have focused on traditional critical infrastructure such as water, electricity, and finance. This foreign cold‑chain hacking case proves that such attacks can have huge societal impact. Chiu reminds that ordinary household smart TVs and internet‑connected refrigerators also pose intrusion and monitoring concerns.

More importantly, Chiu stresses that future government plans to boost cybersecurity and service resilience must incorporate the civilian supply chain. Both enterprises and the public should promptly assess the cybersecurity status, lifecycle, and outsourced management of IoT devices to comprehensively block the pervasive new‑type cyber threats of the AI era.

items.title: 全球股災下的保護傘 全球金融ETF 年化9% 多
items.title_en: Umbrella of Protection Amid Global Stock Crash: Global Financial ETFs Yield Over 9% Annualized

從市場結構來看，先前融資餘額明顯下降，跌停家數也快速收斂，加上部分個股評價已回到相對合理區間，短線確實具備跌深反彈的條件。不過，政策措施有助於改善市場氣氛，並不代表股市已立即反轉，後續仍須觀察外資空單、融資變化，以及企業實際買回庫藏股的執行情況。投資人不宜因政策利多而急於追價，反而應利用市場反彈重新檢視持股，降低基本面轉弱或槓桿過高的部位，並將資金逐步轉向具備長期競爭力、評價相對合理的標的。

而00998A更是將配置範圍延伸至全球金融產業，而非侷限於單一市場。相較於集中布局台灣高股息成分股的ETF，全球金融股配置有機會分散不同國家金融市場、利率環境及產業景氣變化所帶來的影響；在科技股波動加劇時，也提供另一種產業配置選擇。此外，00998A採季配息機制，最新一期年化配息率約9%，對於有現金流需求的投資人而言，也具備一定吸引力。

這也提醒投資人，高股息ETF即使以收益或配息為訴求，仍須回歸成分股、產業配置及市場風險，檢視其實際投資績效；主動式ETF也不代表必然能在空頭市場維持正報酬。尤其部分主動配息型ETF，若市場下跌，導致成分股股息收入或資本利得減少，未來配息水準可能面臨調整壓力。不過，這並不代表所有主動配息型ETF都會出現無法配息的情況，仍須視各基金的收益來源、配息政策及可分配收益而定。投資人不宜只看過去的配息率，更應同步觀察淨值變化與含息總報酬。當市場波動加劇、科技股持倉集中度偏高時，適度將部分資金轉向全球金融等不同產業，有助於分散單一市場與產業風險。配置不應只押注單一國家或科技產業，而應透過全球化布局，兼顧資產分散與收益需求。

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market recently endured a sharp correction, with the drop from the previous peak exceeding 20% at one point. The rapid decline dented market confidence and brought financing balances and liquidity risks to the fore. In response, the government has rolled out a trio of policy supports—deployment of the National Security Fund, short‑selling restrictions, and encouragement for listed companies to conduct share buybacks—aimed at stabilising confidence and easing selling pressure.

From a market‑structure perspective, financing balances have noticeably fallen and the number of stocks hitting daily limits has quickly narrowed. Some stocks have also returned to relatively reasonable valuation ranges, giving the short‑term a technical basis for a rebound. Nevertheless, while policy measures improve market sentiment, they do not guarantee an immediate reversal. Investors should continue to monitor foreign short positions, financing trends, and the actual execution of corporate buybacks. Rather than chasing price gains on policy news, investors should use any bounce to reassess holdings, trim positions with weakening fundamentals or excessive leverage, and gradually shift capital toward assets with long‑term competitive advantages and fair valuations.

Recent volatility in technology stocks has amplified the risk profile of yield‑oriented ETFs. During the heightened market turbulence from Oct. 1 to Nov. 6, the total return (including dividends) of Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878) was –8.31%, while China Trust Taiwan Select High Yield (00919) posted –4.71%; the actively managed CTS Taiwan Income (00406A) fell 29.42%, showing the greatest volatility. By contrast, the actively managed Fuhua Financial Dividend (00998A) delivered a –1.27% total return, demonstrating relatively better downside resilience. Financial stocks, compared with over‑valued tech names, have shown a degree of defensive strength in this correction. Moreover, with the National Security Fund set to enter the market, financial stocks—historically a common allocation for the fund—are likely to benefit further.

Fund 00998A expands its allocation to the global financial industry rather than being confined to a single market. Compared with ETFs that concentrate on Taiwan’s high‑dividend constituents, a global financial stock exposure can diversify across different countries’ financial markets, interest‑rate environments, and industry cycles. When tech volatility spikes, this provides an alternative sectoral tilt. Additionally, 00998A pays dividends quarterly, with the latest annualised yield around 9%, which is attractive for investors seeking cash flow.

This underscores that even high‑dividend ETFs, which market themselves on yield or distribution, must be evaluated on their underlying holdings, sector allocation, and market risk to assess true performance. An active ETF does not automatically deliver positive returns in a bear market. Particularly for actively managed dividend ETFs, a market decline can shrink dividend income or capital gains from constituent stocks, potentially pressuring future payout levels. However, this does not mean all active dividend ETFs will be unable to distribute; outcomes depend on each fund’s income sources, distribution policy, and distributable earnings. Investors should look beyond past yield figures and also track net‑asset‑value changes and total return including dividends. When volatility rises and tech exposure is high, shifting a portion of capital to global financials or other sectors helps diversify away from single‑market and single‑industry risk. Allocation should not be limited to one country or the tech sector but should employ a global approach that balances diversification with income needs.

items.title: 台股連三日飆千點、外資續賣7億元 三大法人土洋對作買超202.56億元
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks surge over 1,000 points for three straight days, foreign investors keep selling NT$7.66 billion; the three major institutional investors net buy NT$202.56 billion
paras: 台股今(11)日延續反彈行情開高走高，在台積電、聯發科雙雙漲逾4%，PCB、散熱及記憶體股同步走強下，午盤漲逾千點，終場進一步收在44,257.15點，大漲1,545.23點、漲幅3.62%，收復4萬4大關，一口氣站回10日均線，成交量8461.95億元；三大法人合計買超202.56億元。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資賣超7.66 億；自營商買超62.57億元；投信買超147.66億元，三大法人合計買超202.56億元。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market continued its rebound today (Nov 11), opening higher and climbing further. With TSMC and MediaTek both gaining more than 4%, and PCB, cooling and memory stocks also strengthening, the index rose over 1,000 points by the midday session and closed at 44,257.15 points, up 1,545.23 points or 3.62%. It reclaimed the 44,000 level and snapped back above the 10‑day moving average, with a turnover of NT$846.195 billion. The three major institutional investors together net bought NT$202.56 billion.

Looking at the trading behavior of the three major institutional investors today: foreign investors sold NT$7.66 billion; proprietary traders bought NT$62.57 billion; and investment trusts bought NT$147.66 billion, resulting in a combined net purchase of NT$202.56 billion by the three groups.

items.title: 美中建立超級智慧對話機制！貝森特：競爭之餘也須防範AI風險 下周川習會登場
items.title_en: U.S. and China Set Up Super‑Intelligence Dialogue Mechanism; Bessent: Competition Must Be Paired With AI Risk Management, Next Week’s Trump‑Xi Meeting Looms
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(10日)表示，美國與中國在合作防範人工智慧(AI)風險的同時，也持續彼此競爭，雙方不應對彼此的分歧抱持「不切實際的幻想」。
貝森特在紐約向美中關係全國委員會發表演說，根據事先準備好的講稿，他表示美中兩國政府已建立一項針對「超級智慧」(super intelligence，SI)的新對話機制，目標是防範「共同面臨的風險」，並避免「兩種體制之間產生誤解」。
貝森特表示，這項機制將讓雙方交流先進模型發布前的測試「最佳實務」，並確保「人類判斷始終牢牢掌控這項技術」。他預期，雙方也會在涉及SI模型的重大事件發生時，互相通報。
不過，貝森特並未承諾限制這項技術的發展。北京與華盛頓目前仍陷入激烈競爭，都希望在AI領域取得全球主導地位。
川普政府大致上仍反對加強限制AI發展，擔心此舉會讓美國失去對中國的競爭優勢。不過美國總統川普近期已釋出訊號，表示對設立監管防護措施持較開放態度。
川普在周日播出的CBS訪問中表示：「我不反對設置防護措施。」但他也說，不希望監管規定讓美國在競爭中「大幅落後中國」，並表示中國並沒有這類限制。
中國外交部今年9月曾駁斥放緩前沿AI模型發展的呼籲，表示散布恐懼與對抗只會干擾全球AI治理。與北京觀點密切一致的智庫「中國與全球化智庫」(CCG)創辦人王輝耀(Huiyao Wang)上月則表示，美中會談應該「正視AI風險，並共同管理這些風險」。

美中9月同意啟動AI對話 川習會下周登場

在中國國家主席習近平9月訪問期間，華盛頓與北京同意啟動AI對話並建立溝通管道，以協助化解重大事件。兩國領袖預定下周第三度會晤，貝森特也將隨行，會談將於11月18-19日舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)領袖峰會期間進行。
貝森特周二在演說中表示，隨著這項技術持續進步，兩國必須展現如何「調和競爭需求與領導責任」。他補充說：「我們的利益不會總是一致，對每項挑戰的應對方式也不會總是相同。」
美國今年6月曾短暫禁止外國人士使用Anthropic的Mythos與Fable 5模型，數周後才恢復使用權。美國政府也已限制向北京出口最先進晶片，並指控中國開發者透過美方所稱的工業規模蒸餾技術，複製美國AI模型。
中國駐美大使謝鋒在當天的晚宴上表示，兩國共同努力對於處理全球衝突熱點，以及「改善AI治理」等議題「不可或缺」。他說，合作「未必能解決所有挑戰」，但「沒有合作，就無法解決任何挑戰」。

黃仁勳下周是否隨團訪中受矚

這場活動舉行之際，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與一名疑為中國間諜的女性發生婚外情，正引發爭議。這名億萬富豪科技高層今年5月曾隨川普代表團訪問北京，9月也受邀出席在華盛頓舉行的國宴。
目前不清楚黃仁勳是否出席下周將舉行的峰會。根據《南華早報》(South China Morning Post)報導，其他可能隨川普下周訪中的企業領袖，則包括特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克，以及萬事達卡(MA-US)執行長Michael Miebach。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday the 10th that while the United States and China are cooperating to guard against artificial‑intelligence (AI) risks, they continue to compete with each other and should not cling to "unrealistic fantasies" about their differences.

Speaking to the National Committee on U.S.–China Relations in New York, Bessent said, according to a prepared script, that the two governments have established a new dialogue mechanism on "super intelligence" (SI) aimed at preventing "shared risks" and avoiding misunderstandings between the two systems.

He explained that the mechanism will let the sides exchange best‑practice testing before advanced models are released and ensure that "human judgment remains firmly in control of the technology." He expects the parties will also notify each other of any major events involving SI models.
However, Bessent did not pledge to curb the development of the technology. Beijing and Washington remain locked in a fierce race, each seeking global leadership in AI.

The Trump administration generally opposes tighter AI restrictions, fearing such moves would erode the U.S. competitive edge over China. Yet President Trump recently signaled a more open stance toward regulatory safeguards.

In a CBS interview aired Sunday, Trump said, "I’m not opposed to putting in safeguards," but added that he does not want regulations to cause the United States to fall "far behind China" in the competition, noting that China has no such limits.

China’s foreign ministry in September rebuffed calls to slow frontier AI model development, saying that spreading fear and confrontation would only hinder global AI governance. Huiyao Wang, founder of the China and Globalization Institute (CCG) and closely aligned with Beijing’s view, said last month that U.S.–China talks should "face AI risks head‑on and manage them together."

During President Xi Jinping’s September visit to China, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue and set up communication channels to help defuse major incidents. The two leaders are slated to meet for the third time next week, with Bessent accompanying them; the talks will take place during the APEC Leaders’ Summit on November 18‑19.

Bessent said in his speech that as the technology advances, the two countries must demonstrate how to "reconcile competitive demands with leadership responsibilities." He added, "Our interests will not always align, and our responses to each challenge will not always be the same."

In June this year the United States briefly banned foreign users from accessing Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable 5 models, restoring access only weeks later. The U.S. government has also limited exports of the most advanced chips to Beijing and accused Chinese developers of using what Washington calls industrial‑scale distillation techniques to replicate U.S. AI models.

Chinese ambassador to the United States Xie Feng told the dinner that joint effort by the two nations is "indispensable" for handling global conflict hotspots and "improving AI governance." He said cooperation may not solve every challenge, but "without cooperation, no challenge can be solved."

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy has drawn attention as the event unfolds. The billionaire tech executive visited Beijing with a Trump delegation in May and was invited to a state dinner in Washington in September.

It remains unclear whether Huang will attend next week’s summit. According to the South China Morning Post, other corporate leaders who may travel to China with the Trump delegation include Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk and Mastercard (MA-US) CEO Michael Miebach.

items.title: 211比204險勝！美眾院擋下彈劾案　但新國會明年就任 赫格塞斯政治麻煩遠未結束
paras: 美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)彈劾危機暫時解除，眾議院周二(10日)就彈劾決議舉行程序性投票，最終以211票贊成、204票反對，決定將彈劾決議移交委員會審議，這項程序性決定實際上使彈劾行動陷入停滯，形同在本屆國會任期內予以否決。
彈劾提案由肯塔基州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Thomas Massie在周一(9日)正式提出，共列出8項彈劾條款，指控赫格塞斯犯下多種「重罪與輕罪」，核心聚焦未經國會授權對伊朗發動軍事行動，另涉及在葉門、委內瑞拉及加勒比地區開展軍事行動、違反《戰爭權力決議》、忽視保護平民法定要求等多項指控。
Massie雖屬共和黨，卻長期與總統川普唱反調，公開批評對伊戰事及援助以色列，他在期中選舉黨內初選中敗給川普支持的對手，年底即將卸任，此次提出彈劾被視為向共和黨同僚施壓，要求就罷免這位川普政府最具爭議內閣成員之一表態，投票結果呈現明顯黨派分野，Massie是唯一與民主黨人一同反對推進彈劾的共和黨議員。
川普隨即在社群媒體發文，稱民主黨針對赫格塞斯的彈劾「慘敗」，並痛斥Massie是「一個徹頭徹尾的失敗者」，同時指控民主黨將彈劾當作政治武器、持續「武器化」美國加以濫用。
川普指出，除Massie外，其他共和黨人都投票支持赫格塞斯。他周一在白宮答覆《CNN》記者提問時更力挺赫格塞斯：「我會支持他。他贏了兩場戰爭。他是負責人，我們都贏了。」他還回嗆記者與Massie，稱不應讓此人佔用國會時間。
此次彈劾風波正值共和黨在上周二(3日)期中選舉慘敗餘波之際，黨內將失利部分歸咎於伊朗戰事拖累。
赫格塞斯周二開記者會堅稱，彈劾是「由政策分歧驅動的政治鬧劇」，強調自己實施的是合法且成功的軍事行動，並將此舉與川普先前兩度遭彈劾相提並論，表示「這一套對我沒用」。
然而，隨著民主黨重奪參眾兩院控制權，新國會明年就任後勢必掀起更大規模調查，赫格塞斯的麻煩恐怕遠未結束。

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”

items.title: 銅金需求爆發推升礦商獲利 貝萊德黃金及礦業ETF募集至11/13
items.title_en: Copper Demand Surge Drives Mining Profits, BlackRock Gold and Mining ETFs Raise Capital Until 11/13
paras: 自今年11月以來，金價雖短暫回檔，仍穩居每盎司4000美元之上展現韌性。上周全球股市因人工智慧類股回檔大幅震盪，資金急尋新出口，此際發行黃金礦業ETF正提供避險與參與建設大行情利多，貝萊德兩檔黃金礦業ETF自即日起募集至13日，看準黃金和礦業產業的紅利浮現，助投資人卡位「黃金」行情。
回顧10月底起僅5個交易日，美國那斯達克100指數跌逾4%，台灣股市跌幅逾12%。反觀世界金礦指數同期間逆勢大漲約12.76%，皆以新台幣計算。數據反映資金正從擁擠的人工智慧概念股撤出，尋找具基本面支撐標的。貝萊德投信透過全新ETF，讓投資人參與全球黃金價值與礦業升級契機，分散科技股風險。
擬任經理人楊貽甯表示，市場波動之際黃金與礦業成為資金焦點，長期股票表現相較實體價格漲勢更鮮明。彭博資料顯示2016至2025年間國際金價累計上漲約307%，同期金礦股指數漲幅達634%，超越金價兩倍。同期間銅價上漲166%，礦業股指數漲幅約328%，同樣近兩倍，焦點轉向具營運槓桿類股。
楊貽甯分析，金礦股在多頭期間展現高價格彈性的關鍵來自營運槓桿。當金價上漲且開採成本穩定時，增加的收入將反映在礦商利潤。統計2024至2026年數據，若假設2026年金價持平於2025年底，金價漲幅估約82%，金礦商營運現金利潤增幅可達163%，呈現2倍槓桿效果，長期報酬有機會勝過金價本身。
礦業發展方面，目前長期結構已不只由景氣循環驅動，人工智慧、電氣化及國防支出皆推升銅鋁鋼鎳等需求。全球資料中心規模預估由2025年的82GW增至2030年的219GW，放大逾2.6倍。每新增1MW容量需60至75噸金屬，預估新增需求達822萬至1027萬噸，供給無法跟上成為支撐礦業投資的結構力量。
世界黃金ETF (009834-TW) 追蹤富時TIP世界黃金指數，布局全球金銀礦業。世界礦業ETF (009835-TW) 追蹤富時TIP世界礦業指數，投資涵蓋開採至設備零組件。兩檔基金即日至13日募集，未來於櫃買中心掛牌。投資人可藉此參與基礎建設帶動的資源需求，為資產配置增加不同於傳統股債的選擇。
paras_en: Since November, gold prices have remained resilient above $4,000 per ounce despite a brief pullback. Last week, global equity markets were heavily shaken by a decline in AI stocks, prompting investors to seek new outlets. At this juncture, issuing gold mining ETFs provides both a hedge and a way to participate in the burgeoning construction rally. BlackRock’s two gold mining ETFs are now open for subscription until the 13th, capitalizing on the emerging dividends in the gold and mining sectors to help investors position themselves for the “gold” rally.

From the end of October to just five trading days, the Nasdaq 100 fell more than 4% and Taiwan’s market dropped over 12%. In contrast, the world gold mining index rose about 12.76% over the same period, all in New Taiwan dollars. The data shows capital is pulling out of crowded AI concept stocks and seeking fundamentals‑backed assets. BlackRock’s new ETF allows investors to tap into global gold value and mining upgrade opportunities, diversifying away from tech stocks.

Managing director Yang Yi‑ning said that amid market volatility, gold and mining have become the focus of capital, with long‑term stock performance more pronounced than the rise in physical prices. Bloomberg data shows that from 2016 to 2025, international gold prices rose about 307%, while the gold mining index climbed 634%, more than twice the gold price. During the same period, copper rose 166% and the mining index gained about 328%, again nearly double, shifting focus to operating‑leveraged stocks.

Yang Yi‑ning explained that gold mining stocks exhibit high price elasticity during bull markets due to operating leverage. When gold prices rise and extraction costs remain stable, increased revenue translates into mining profits. Statistics from 2024 to 2026 suggest that if gold prices in 2026 remain flat relative to the end of 2025, the price increase would be about 82%, while mining operators’ cash profit could rise 163%, showing a two‑fold leverage effect and potentially outpacing gold price gains over the long term.

In terms of mining development, the long‑term structure is no longer driven solely by economic cycles; AI, electrification, and defense spending are all boosting demand for copper, aluminum, steel, nickel, and more. Global data center capacity is projected to grow from 82 GW in 2025 to 219 GW in 2030, a 2.6‑fold increase. Each additional 1 MW of capacity requires 60 to 75 tons of metal, estimating new demand at 8.22 million to 10.27 million tons, with supply unable to keep pace, providing structural support for mining investment.

The World Gold ETF (009834‑TW) tracks the FTSE TIP World Gold Index, positioning itself in global gold and silver mining. The World Mining ETF (009835‑TW) tracks the FTSE TIP World Mining Index, covering everything from extraction to equipment components. Both funds are open for subscription until the 13th and will later list on the OTC market. Investors can use them to participate in resource demand driven by infrastructure, adding a non‑traditional equity‑bond alternative to their asset allocation.

items.title: 全球股災下的保護傘 全球金融ETF 年化9% 多
items.title_en: Umbrella of Protection Amid Global Stock Crash: Global Financial ETFs Yield Over 9% Annualized
paras: 台股近期經歷一波劇烈修正，從前波高點回落幅度一度超過兩成，短時間內快速下跌，不僅衝擊市場信心，也讓融資籌碼與流動性風險浮上檯面。面對急跌行情，政府陸續祭出國安基金進場、限制放空，以及鼓勵上市櫃公司實施庫藏股等措施，形成政策護盤三箭，有助於穩定市場信心並降低賣壓。
從市場結構來看，先前融資餘額明顯下降，跌停家數也快速收斂，加上部分個股評價已回到相對合理區間，短線確實具備跌深反彈的條件。不過，政策措施有助於改善市場氣氛，並不代表股市已立即反轉，後續仍須觀察外資空單、融資變化，以及企業實際買回庫藏股的執行情況。投資人不宜因政策利多而急於追價，反而應利用市場反彈重新檢視持股，降低基本面轉弱或槓桿過高的部位，並將資金逐步轉向具備長期競爭力、評價相對合理的標的。

近期科技股大幅震盪，也讓收益型ETF面臨波動放大的風險。觀察10月1日至11月6日這段市場波動加劇期間，國泰永續高股息（00878）區間含息報酬率為-8.31%，群益台灣精選高息（00919）為-4.71%；主動中信台灣收益（00406A）則下跌29.42%，波動幅度相對突出。相較之下，主動復華金融股息（00998A）同期含息報酬率為-1.27%，在這幾檔商品中展現較佳的抗跌表現。金融股相較部分評價較高的科技股，在這波市場修正中也展現一定的抗跌特性。此外，隨著國安基金即將進場，若參考過往國安基金進場布局的標的，金融股也是常見的配置族群之一，將更有利於金融股接下來的表現。
而00998A更是將配置範圍延伸至全球金融產業，而非侷限於單一市場。相較於集中布局台灣高股息成分股的ETF，全球金融股配置有機會分散不同國家金融市場、利率環境及產業景氣變化所帶來的影響；在科技股波動加劇時，也提供另一種產業配置選擇。此外，00998A採季配息機制，最新一期年化配息率約9%，對於有現金流需求的投資人而言，也具備一定吸引力。

items.title_en: Copper Demand Surge Drives Mining Profits, BlackRock Gold and Mining ETFs Raise Capital Until 11/13
paras: 自今年11月以來，金價雖短暫回檔，仍穩居每盎司4000美元之上展現韌性。上周全球股市因人工智慧類股回檔大幅震盪，資金急尋新出口，此際發行黃金礦業ETF正提供避險與參與建設大行情利多，貝萊德兩檔黃金礦業ETF自即日起募集至13日，看準黃金和礦業產業的紅利浮現，助投資人卡位「黃金」行情。
回顧10月底起僅5個交易日，美國那斯達克100指數跌逾4%，台灣股市跌幅逾12%。反觀世界金礦指數同期間逆勢大漲約12.76%，皆以新台幣計算。數據反映資金正從擁擠的人工智慧概念股撤出，尋找具基本面支撐標的。貝萊德投信透過全新ETF，讓投資人參與全球黃金價值與礦業升級契機，分散科技股風險。
擬任經理人楊貽甯表示，市場波動之際黃金與礦業成為資金焦點，長期股票表現相較實體價格漲勢更鮮明。彭博資料顯示2016至2025年間國際金價累計上漲約307%，同期金礦股指數漲幅達634%，超越金價兩倍。同期間銅價上漲166%，礦業股指數漲幅約328%，同樣近兩倍，焦點轉向具營運槓桿類股。
楊貽甯分析，金礦股在多頭期間展現高價格彈性的關鍵來自營運槓桿。當金價上漲且開採成本穩定時，增加的收入將反映在礦商利潤。統計2024至2026年數據，若假設2026年金價持平於2025年底，金價漲幅估約82%，金礦商營運現金利潤增幅可達163%，呈現2倍槓桿效果，長期報酬有機會勝過金價本身。
礦業發展方面，目前長期結構已不只由景氣循環驅動，人工智慧、電氣化及國防支出皆推升銅鋁鋼鎳等需求。全球資料中心規模預估由2025年的82GW增至2030年的219GW，放大逾2.6倍。每新增1MW容量需60至75噸金屬，預估新增需求達822萬至1027萬噸，供給無法跟上成為支撐礦業投資的結構力量。
世界黃金ETF (009834-TW) 追蹤富時TIP世界黃金指數，布局全球金銀礦業。世界礦業ETF (009835-TW) 追蹤富時TIP世界礦業指數，投資涵蓋開採至設備零組件。兩檔基金即日至13日募集，未來於櫃買中心掛牌。投資人可藉此參與基礎建設帶動的資源需求，為資產配置增加不同於傳統股債的選擇。
paras_en: Since November, gold prices have remained resilient above $4,000 per ounce despite a brief pullback. Last week, global equity markets were heavily shaken by a decline in AI stocks, prompting investors to seek new outlets. At this juncture, issuing gold mining ETFs provides both a hedge and a way to participate in the burgeoning construction rally. BlackRock’s two gold mining ETFs are now open for subscription until the 13th, capitalizing on the emerging dividends in the gold and mining sectors to help investors position themselves for the “gold” rally.

From the end of October to just five trading days, the Nasdaq 100 fell more than 4% and Taiwan’s market dropped over 12%. In contrast, the world gold mining index rose about 12.76% over the same period, all in New Taiwan dollars. The data shows capital is pulling out of crowded AI concept stocks and seeking fundamentals‑backed assets. BlackRock’s new ETF allows investors to tap into global gold value and mining upgrade opportunities, diversifying away from tech stocks.

Managing director Yang Yi‑ning said that amid market volatility, gold and mining have become the focus of capital, with long‑term stock performance more pronounced than the rise in physical prices. Bloomberg data shows that from 2016 to 2025, international gold prices rose about 307%, while the gold mining index climbed 634%, more than twice the gold price. During the same period, copper rose 166% and the mining index gained about 328%, again nearly double, shifting focus to operating‑leveraged stocks.

Yang Yi‑ning explained that gold mining stocks exhibit high price elasticity during bull markets due to operating leverage. When gold prices rise and extraction costs remain stable, increased revenue translates into mining profits. Statistics from 2024 to 2026 suggest that if gold prices in 2026 remain flat relative to the end of 2025, the price increase would be about 82%, while mining operators’ cash profit could rise 163%, showing a two‑fold leverage effect and potentially outpacing gold price gains over the long term.

In terms of mining development, the long‑term structure is no longer driven solely by economic cycles; AI, electrification, and defense spending are all boosting demand for copper, aluminum, steel, nickel, and more. Global data center capacity is projected to grow from 82 GW in 2025 to 219 GW in 2030, a 2.6‑fold increase. Each additional 1 MW of capacity requires 60 to 75 tons of metal, estimating new demand at 8.22 million to 10.27 million tons, with supply unable to keep pace, providing structural support for mining investment.

The World Gold ETF (009834‑TW) tracks the FTSE TIP World Gold Index, positioning itself in global gold and silver mining. The World Mining ETF (009835‑TW) tracks the FTSE TIP World Mining Index, covering everything from extraction to equipment components. Both funds are open for subscription until the 13th and will later list on the OTC market. Investors can use them to participate in resource demand driven by infrastructure, adding a non‑traditional equity‑bond alternative to their asset allocation.

items.title: 和運租車長租服務取得ISO碳足跡查證
items.title_en: He Yun Car Rental Long-Term Service Achieves ISO Carbon Footprint Verification
paras: 隨著全球供應鏈減碳要求日益嚴苛，商務用車等範疇三(Scope 3)碳排管理已成企業 ESG 盤查重點，台灣汽車租賃領導品牌和運租車(7855-TW)今(11)日指出，核心業務「車輛租賃服務」正式通過 ISO 14067:2018 產品碳足跡查證，並取得第三方機構合理保證等級聲明書。
和運表示，將透過碳數據透明化，協助客戶直接引用權威數據，顯著降低供應鏈盤查成本。
為響應和泰集團「2050 淨零排放」願景，和運租車自 2024 年導入 ISO 14064-1 溫室氣體盤查，並設定 2030 年減碳 25% 目標；本次查證以 2025 年營運數據為基準，涵蓋全台長租據點，盤點從簽約、據點營運、保養維修、代步車派遣至廢棄物處理等全生命週期碳排放。
和運租車以「每台車行駛 1 萬公里」為標準計算單位，聚焦租賃服務本身碳排，與客戶駕駛產生的燃油與電力消耗做區隔，盤查顯示，「車輛保養維修」為主要碳排來源，占整體服務碳排近三分之二。
和運指出，將以此次盤查結果為基礎，持續評估保養維修流程、據點能源使用和服務數位化等改善方向，確實轉化為減碳行動。
另一方面，針對保養維修占比最高的問題，盤查結果顯示，純電動車(BEV)在保養維修階段碳排較燃油車大幅減少逾 25%，突顯車隊電動化為減碳核心策略。
因此，為協助客戶加速建構低碳車隊，和運積極推出「綠色租賃車隊專案」，提供包括 Toyota、Lexus、Tesla和多品牌純電車款的彈性配置，並延伸至場域充電樁建置服務，以「和運充電 APP」跨平台整合全台近 20 家充電營運商資源，讓車主透過單一 APP 即可使用全台充電站。
paras_en: As global supply chain carbon reduction requirements become increasingly stringent, Scope 3 carbon emissions management for categories such as business‑use vehicles has become a key focus of corporate ESG audits. Taiwan’s leading car‑rental brand He Yun Car Rental (7855‑TW) announced today (the 11th) that its core business “vehicle rental service” has officially passed ISO 14067:2018 product carbon‑footprint verification and received a third‑party reasonable assurance statement.
He Yun said it will increase carbon‑data transparency to help customers directly cite authoritative data, significantly lowering the cost of supply‑chain audits.

In line with the HETAI Group’s “2050 Net‑Zero Emission” vision, He Yun Car Rental introduced ISO 14064‑1 greenhouse‑gas accounting in 2024 and set a target to cut emissions by 25% by 2030; this verification used 2025 operational data as a baseline, covering all long‑term rental locations across Taiwan and accounting for the full life‑cycle emissions from contract signing, site operation, maintenance, vehicle dispatch to waste disposal.

He Yun calculates emissions using a standard of “10,000 km driven per vehicle,” focusing on the carbon impact of the rental service itself and separating it from the fuel and electricity consumption generated by customers’ driving. The audit shows that “vehicle maintenance and repair” is the main source of emissions, accounting for nearly two‑thirds of the total service carbon footprint.

He Yun indicated that it will use the results of this audit as a basis to continuously evaluate maintenance processes, site energy use and service digitization, turning these insights into concrete emission‑reduction actions.

Regarding the high share of maintenance emissions, the audit found that pure‑electric vehicles (BEVs) reduce maintenance‑phase emissions by more than 25% compared with gasoline cars, highlighting fleet electrification as a core decarbonization strategy.

Therefore, to help customers accelerate the building of low‑carbon fleets, He Yun is actively launching a “Green Rental Fleet Project,” offering flexible configurations of Toyota, Lexus, Tesla and other multi‑brand pure‑electric models, and extending services to on‑site charging‑station installation. Through the “He Yun Charging APP,” it integrates resources from nearly 20 charging operators nationwide, allowing vehicle owners to access any charging station across Taiwan via a single app.

items.title: 美中建立超級智慧對話機制！貝森特：競爭之餘也須防範AI風險 下周川習會登場
items.title_en: U.S. and China Set Up Super‑Intelligence Dialogue Mechanism; Bessent: Competition Must Be Paired With AI Risk Management, Next Week’s Trump‑Xi Meeting Looms
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(10日)表示，美國與中國在合作防範人工智慧(AI)風險的同時，也持續彼此競爭，雙方不應對彼此的分歧抱持「不切實際的幻想」。
貝森特在紐約向美中關係全國委員會發表演說，根據事先準備好的講稿，他表示美中兩國政府已建立一項針對「超級智慧」(super intelligence，SI)的新對話機制，目標是防範「共同面臨的風險」，並避免「兩種體制之間產生誤解」。
貝森特表示，這項機制將讓雙方交流先進模型發布前的測試「最佳實務」，並確保「人類判斷始終牢牢掌控這項技術」。他預期，雙方也會在涉及SI模型的重大事件發生時，互相通報。
不過，貝森特並未承諾限制這項技術的發展。北京與華盛頓目前仍陷入激烈競爭，都希望在AI領域取得全球主導地位。
川普政府大致上仍反對加強限制AI發展，擔心此舉會讓美國失去對中國的競爭優勢。不過美國總統川普近期已釋出訊號，表示對設立監管防護措施持較開放態度。
川普在周日播出的CBS訪問中表示：「我不反對設置防護措施。」但他也說，不希望監管規定讓美國在競爭中「大幅落後中國」，並表示中國並沒有這類限制。
中國外交部今年9月曾駁斥放緩前沿AI模型發展的呼籲，表示散布恐懼與對抗只會干擾全球AI治理。與北京觀點密切一致的智庫「中國與全球化智庫」(CCG)創辦人王輝耀(Huiyao Wang)上月則表示，美中會談應該「正視AI風險，並共同管理這些風險」。

美中9月同意啟動AI對話 川習會下周登場

在中國國家主席習近平9月訪問期間，華盛頓與北京同意啟動AI對話並建立溝通管道，以協助化解重大事件。兩國領袖預定下周第三度會晤，貝森特也將隨行，會談將於11月18-19日舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)領袖峰會期間進行。
貝森特周二在演說中表示，隨著這項技術持續進步，兩國必須展現如何「調和競爭需求與領導責任」。他補充說：「我們的利益不會總是一致，對每項挑戰的應對方式也不會總是相同。」
美國今年6月曾短暫禁止外國人士使用Anthropic的Mythos與Fable 5模型，數周後才恢復使用權。美國政府也已限制向北京出口最先進晶片，並指控中國開發者透過美方所稱的工業規模蒸餾技術，複製美國AI模型。
中國駐美大使謝鋒在當天的晚宴上表示，兩國共同努力對於處理全球衝突熱點，以及「改善AI治理」等議題「不可或缺」。他說，合作「未必能解決所有挑戰」，但「沒有合作，就無法解決任何挑戰」。

黃仁勳下周是否隨團訪中受矚

這場活動舉行之際，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與一名疑為中國間諜的女性發生婚外情，正引發爭議。這名億萬富豪科技高層今年5月曾隨川普代表團訪問北京，9月也受邀出席在華盛頓舉行的國宴。
目前不清楚黃仁勳是否出席下周將舉行的峰會。根據《南華早報》(South China Morning Post)報導，其他可能隨川普下周訪中的企業領袖，則包括特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克，以及萬事達卡(MA-US)執行長Michael Miebach。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday the 10th that while the United States and China are cooperating to guard against artificial‑intelligence (AI) risks, they continue to compete with each other and should not cling to "unrealistic fantasies" about their differences.

Speaking to the National Committee on U.S.–China Relations in New York, Bessent said, according to a prepared script, that the two governments have established a new dialogue mechanism on "super intelligence" (SI) aimed at preventing "shared risks" and avoiding misunderstandings between the two systems.

He explained that the mechanism will let the sides exchange best‑practice testing before advanced models are released and ensure that "human judgment remains firmly in control of the technology." He expects the parties will also notify each other of any major events involving SI models.
However, Bessent did not pledge to curb the development of the technology. Beijing and Washington remain locked in a fierce race, each seeking global leadership in AI.

The Trump administration generally opposes tighter AI restrictions, fearing such moves would erode the U.S. competitive edge over China. Yet President Trump recently signaled a more open stance toward regulatory safeguards.

In a CBS interview aired Sunday, Trump said, "I’m not opposed to putting in safeguards," but added that he does not want regulations to cause the United States to fall "far behind China" in the competition, noting that China has no such limits.

China’s foreign ministry in September rebuffed calls to slow frontier AI model development, saying that spreading fear and confrontation would only hinder global AI governance. Huiyao Wang, founder of the China and Globalization Institute (CCG) and closely aligned with Beijing’s view, said last month that U.S.–China talks should "face AI risks head‑on and manage them together."

During President Xi Jinping’s September visit to China, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue and set up communication channels to help defuse major incidents. The two leaders are slated to meet for the third time next week, with Bessent accompanying them; the talks will take place during the APEC Leaders’ Summit on November 18‑19.

Bessent said in his speech that as the technology advances, the two countries must demonstrate how to "reconcile competitive demands with leadership responsibilities." He added, "Our interests will not always align, and our responses to each challenge will not always be the same."

In June this year the United States briefly banned foreign users from accessing Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable 5 models, restoring access only weeks later. The U.S. government has also limited exports of the most advanced chips to Beijing and accused Chinese developers of using what Washington calls industrial‑scale distillation techniques to replicate U.S. AI models.

Chinese ambassador to the United States Xie Feng told the dinner that joint effort by the two nations is "indispensable" for handling global conflict hotspots and "improving AI governance." He said cooperation may not solve every challenge, but "without cooperation, no challenge can be solved."

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy has drawn attention as the event unfolds. The billionaire tech executive visited Beijing with a Trump delegation in May and was invited to a state dinner in Washington in September.

It remains unclear whether Huang will attend next week’s summit. According to the South China Morning Post, other corporate leaders who may travel to China with the Trump delegation include Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk and Mastercard (MA-US) CEO Michael Miebach.

items.title: 211比204險勝！美眾院擋下彈劾案　但新國會明年就任 赫格塞斯政治麻煩遠未結束
paras: 美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)彈劾危機暫時解除，眾議院周二(10日)就彈劾決議舉行程序性投票，最終以211票贊成、204票反對，決定將彈劾決議移交委員會審議，這項程序性決定實際上使彈劾行動陷入停滯，形同在本屆國會任期內予以否決。
彈劾提案由肯塔基州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Thomas Massie在周一(9日)正式提出，共列出8項彈劾條款，指控赫格塞斯犯下多種「重罪與輕罪」，核心聚焦未經國會授權對伊朗發動軍事行動，另涉及在葉門、委內瑞拉及加勒比地區開展軍事行動、違反《戰爭權力決議》、忽視保護平民法定要求等多項指控。
Massie雖屬共和黨，卻長期與總統川普唱反調，公開批評對伊戰事及援助以色列，他在期中選舉黨內初選中敗給川普支持的對手，年底即將卸任，此次提出彈劾被視為向共和黨同僚施壓，要求就罷免這位川普政府最具爭議內閣成員之一表態，投票結果呈現明顯黨派分野，Massie是唯一與民主黨人一同反對推進彈劾的共和黨議員。
川普隨即在社群媒體發文，稱民主黨針對赫格塞斯的彈劾「慘敗」，並痛斥Massie是「一個徹頭徹尾的失敗者」，同時指控民主黨將彈劾當作政治武器、持續「武器化」美國加以濫用。
川普指出，除Massie外，其他共和黨人都投票支持赫格塞斯。他周一在白宮答覆《CNN》記者提問時更力挺赫格塞斯：「我會支持他。他贏了兩場戰爭。他是負責人，我們都贏了。」他還回嗆記者與Massie，稱不應讓此人佔用國會時間。
此次彈劾風波正值共和黨在上周二(3日)期中選舉慘敗餘波之際，黨內將失利部分歸咎於伊朗戰事拖累。
赫格塞斯周二開記者會堅稱，彈劾是「由政策分歧驅動的政治鬧劇」，強調自己實施的是合法且成功的軍事行動，並將此舉與川普先前兩度遭彈劾相提並論，表示「這一套對我沒用」。
然而，隨著民主黨重奪參眾兩院控制權，新國會明年就任後勢必掀起更大規模調查，赫格塞斯的麻煩恐怕遠未結束。

items.title: 福斯收購Roku後啟動80億美元債券發行！最長年期達40年
items.title_en: Fox Launches $8 Billion Bond Issuance After Acquiring Roku, Longest Maturity 40 Years
paras: 美國媒體公司福斯(FOX-US) 完成以220億美元收購串流平台Roku(ROKU-US) 後，隨即啟動大規模債券籌資，計畫透過發行投資級債券募集約80億美元，以償還部分收購融資。
根據《彭博》周二（10日）引述知情人士報導，福斯已開始分七批發行投資級債券，期限從3年至40年不等。其中，期限最長的債券發行利率，較美國公債殖利率高出約2.25個百分點。
此次債券發行由摩根士丹利(MS-US) 主導承銷，花旗集團(C-US) 、德意志銀行(DB-US) 、高盛集團(GS-US) 及摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 也參與其中。募集資金將用於償還一筆84億美元的過橋貸款，這筆貸款先前用於支應收購Roku的部分現金對價。
福斯與Roku的收購案於今年6月宣布，採現金加股票方式支付，並於上周五（6日）完成交易。
透過這筆收購，福斯將能接觸使用Roku平台的逾1億個家庭，有助於這家主要仰賴有線電視業務的媒體公司擴大數位觀眾規模，並提升廣告投放的精準度。
《彭博》報導另指出，福斯預計在收購完成後的兩年內，每年節省約4億美元成本。
paras_en: After completing its $22 billion acquisition of streaming platform Roku (ROKU-US), U.S. media company Fox (FOX-US) immediately kicked off a large‑scale bond financing, planning to raise about $8 billion by issuing investment‑grade bonds to repay part of the acquisition financing.

According to Bloomberg on Tuesday (the 10th), citing sources familiar with the matter, Fox has begun issuing investment‑grade bonds in seven tranches with maturities ranging from 3 to 40 years. The longest‑dated bonds carry a yield roughly 2.25 percentage points above the U.S. Treasury rate.

The bond offering is led by Morgan Stanley (MS-US) as bookrunner, with participation from Citigroup (C-US), Deutsche Bank (DB-US), Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US). The proceeds will be used to repay an $8.4 billion bridge loan that was previously drawn to fund part of the cash consideration for the Roku acquisition.
Fox and Roku announced the acquisition in June of this year, using a mix of cash and stock, and completed the transaction last Friday (the 6th).

Through the deal, Fox will gain access to more than 100 million households that use the Roku platform, helping the media company—traditionally reliant on cable TV—to expand its digital audience and improve the precision of its advertising targeting.
Bloomberg also reported that Fox expects to save about $400 million in costs each year for the two years following the completion of the acquisition.

items.title: 51個月首見！特斯拉中國10月銷量暴跌66.1%至8817輛　Model Y從銷量居首跌至66名
items.title_en: First Drop in 51 Months! Tesla China October Sales Plummet 66.1% to 8,817 Units, Model Y Falls from Top Spot to 66th
paras: 根據懂車帝排行榜數據，特斯拉10月在中國銷量合計僅8817輛，其中Model Y零售7807輛，排名自9月第1位暴跌至第66位；Model 3零售1010輛。
相較之下，中國乘聯分會數據顯示，特斯拉中國10月批發銷量達67829輛，年增10.3%、月減28.88%，創今年2月來最低，零售與批發數據出現顯著落差。
《新浪網》報導，特斯拉上海超級工廠每季前兩個月優先供應海外市場，導致中國國內車源緊縮，是季度初零售波動的主因，但上月零售跌破萬輛關卡，距離上次已時隔51個月，實屬罕見。更深層原因在於9月促銷透支需求，當月Model 3現車直降5000元(人民幣，下同)、Model Y優惠1萬元，刺激大量潛在用戶集中下單，推升9月零售至6.48萬輛的年內高點，但也預支10月買氣。
產品線單薄亦是隱憂。自在中國生產以來，特斯拉在中國僅銷售Model 3與Model Y兩款車型，儘管進行過改款，但更新幅度有限。面對中國新能源車廠在智慧化、座艙體驗與定價策略上的強勢競爭，消費者可選品牌增多，「買車買品牌」的觀念逐漸淡化，特斯拉傳統優勢不再具備絕對吸引力。
中國車市環境同樣嚴峻。根據乘聯分會數據顯示，10月中國國內乘用車零售164.3萬輛，年減27.1%，今年前10月累計零售年減22.3%，存量市場競爭加劇。今年前9月，特斯拉在中國累計零售38.11萬輛，年減11.93%，6月至9月連4月呈年減走勢。
特斯拉品牌認知度猶存，Model Y市場表現仍有目共睹，但在競爭產品林立、內卷激烈的市場中，產品力與品牌吸引力能否持續留住消費者，將決定特斯拉在中國的基本盤的穩固與否。推出全新產品尋求增量，已是當務之急。
paras_en: According to data from the Dongchedi ranking, Tesla sold only 8,817 vehicles in China in October, with 7,807 Model Y units sold at retail. The Model Y’s ranking tumbled from first place in September to 66th, while Model 3 retail sales were 1,010 units.

In contrast, data from the China Passenger Car Association shows Tesla’s wholesale sales in China reached 67,829 units in October, up 10.3% year‑on‑year but down 28.88% month‑on‑month, marking the lowest level since February this year and highlighting a sharp gap between retail and wholesale figures.

Sina News reported that Tesla’s Shanghai Gigafactory prioritises overseas markets for the first two months of each quarter, tightening domestic supply and causing the early‑quarter retail swing. October’s retail fell below the 10,000‑unit threshold for the first time in 51 months, a rare occurrence. A deeper cause was the September promotion that over‑drawn demand: Model 3 inventory was discounted by ¥5,000 and Model Y by ¥10,000, prompting a surge of orders that pushed September retail to a yearly high of 64,800 units, but essentially prepaid October’s demand.

A thin product line is also a concern. Since starting local production, Tesla has only offered the Model 3 and Model Y in China. Although facelifts have been introduced, the updates are modest. Facing strong competition from Chinese EV makers on smart features, cabin experience and pricing, consumers now have more brand choices and the “buy the brand” mindset is fading, eroding Tesla’s traditional advantage.

The Chinese car market environment is equally tough. Data from the Passenger Car Association shows that retail sales of passenger cars in China fell to 1.643 million units in October, down 27.1% year‑on‑year, and cumulative retail sales for the first ten months of the year were down 22.3% year‑on‑year, intensifying competition in the mature market. In the first nine months of the year, Tesla’s cumulative retail sales in China were 381,100 units, down 11.93% year‑on‑year, with a year‑on‑year decline observed from June through September.

Tesla’s brand awareness remains, and the Model Y’s market performance is still noticeable, but in a market crowded with competing products and intense internal competition, the ability of its product strength and brand appeal to retain consumers will determine whether Tesla can secure its core base in China. Launching new models to generate incremental growth has become an urgent priority.

items.title: 諾和諾德、禮來「減肥神藥」爆失明危機？美FDA：須加註罕見眼疾警示
items.title_en: Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly 'Weight‑Loss Miracle' Faces Blindness Risk? US FDA: Must Add Rare Eye Disease Warning
paras: 美國食品藥物管理局(FDA) 9日發布最新安全警訊，要求所有 GLP-1 腸抑胃素受體促效劑類藥物，必須在藥品說明書的警示欄位中，加註可能引發罕見眼疾「非動脈性前部缺血性視神經病變」(NAION)的潛在風險。
這類藥物包括諾和諾德(NVO-US)的 Ozempic 與 Wegovy、禮來(LLY-US)的 Mounjaro 與 Zepbound，以及賽諾菲的 Soliqua等，因為被用於降糖、減肥治療，被視為所謂「減肥神藥」。
NAION 是由於供應視神經的血管血流突然減少或阻塞，致使視神經缺氧所引發。其主要症狀為單眼出現突然且無痛的視力減退，嚴重者可能造成永久性失明，且目前尚無有效療法可逆轉視力損傷。
FDA 在分析 126 項臨床試驗、涵蓋逾 13.4 萬名患者的數據後發現，GLP-1 使用者的 NAION 發生率為每 10 萬人年 6.4 例，高於安慰劑或非 GLP-1 降血糖藥物組的 3.8 例，因而認定存在潛在風險。
針對 FDA 的警示，諾和諾德發言人表示，公司「仍認為現有數據並未建立因果關係，對 GLP-1 藥物的效益與風險特徵保持信心」，並強調「患者安全是諾和諾德的首要任務，將持續監控藥品安全性並與全球衛生主管機關合作」。
禮來聲明指出，公司正在「仔細評估此項更新，並將迅速回應 FDA」，同時重申患者安全為其首要考量。
美國眼科學會(AAO)發表聲明強調：「任何增加的風險似乎都很小，且尚未證實這些藥物會直接導致 NAION」，並向患者呼籲，「切勿在未諮詢醫師的情況下擅自停藥；若發現單眼突然出現無痛性視力喪失，應立即就診眼科」。
哈佛醫學院眼科教授Dr. Joseph Rizzo(2024 年相關研究作者之一)指出，先前發現使用司美格魯肽(Semaglutide)者診斷出 NAION 機率較高的研究結果雖然「顯著，但仍屬初步」，未來仍需針對更廣泛多元的人群進行深入研究。
由於糖尿病本身即為 NAION 的已知風險因子，加上高血壓、高膽固醇及吸菸等共病因素，醫療界普遍認為藥物與眼疾之間的確切因果鏈結仍有待進一步釐清。
paras_en: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on the 9th issued a new safety alert requiring that all GLP‑1 receptor agonist drugs include a warning in the prescribing information about the potential risk of a rare eye disease called non‑arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION).

These drugs include Novo Nordisk’s (NVO‑US) Ozempic and Wegovy, Eli Lilly’s (LLY‑US) Mounjaro and Zepbound, as well as Sanofi’s Soliqua, which are used for diabetes control and weight‑loss treatment and are regarded as so‑called “weight‑loss miracle” drugs.

NAION occurs when the blood flow to the optic nerve suddenly decreases or becomes blocked, causing oxygen deprivation of the nerve. Its main symptom is a sudden, painless loss of vision in one eye; severe cases can lead to permanent blindness, and there is currently no effective therapy to reverse the damage.

After analyzing data from 126 clinical trials involving more than 134,000 patients, the FDA found that the incidence of NAION among GLP‑1 users was 6.4 cases per 100,000 person‑years, higher than the 3.8 cases per 100,000 person‑years observed in placebo or non‑GLP‑1 glucose‑lowering drug groups, indicating a potential risk.

In response to the FDA warning, a Novo Nordisk spokesperson said the company “still believes the existing data do not establish a causal relationship, remains confident in the benefit‑risk profile of GLP‑1 drugs,” and emphasized that “patient safety is Novo Nordisk’s top priority, and we will continue to monitor drug safety and work with health authorities worldwide.”
Eli Lilly stated that it is “carefully evaluating this update and will respond to the FDA promptly,” while reiterating that patient safety is its primary concern.

The American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) issued a statement emphasizing that “any increased risk appears to be very small and it has not been proven that these drugs directly cause NAION,” and urged patients “not to stop the medication without consulting a physician; if you experience sudden painless loss of vision in one eye, seek ophthalmic care immediately.”

Harvard Medical School ophthalmology professor Dr. Joseph Rizzo, one of the authors of a 2024 study, noted that earlier findings showing a higher probability of NAION among semaglutide users were “significant but still preliminary,” and that further research in broader, more diverse populations is needed.

Because diabetes itself is a known risk factor for NAION, and comorbidities such as hypertension, high cholesterol and smoking also contribute, the medical community generally believes that the exact causal link between the drugs and the eye disease remains to be clarified.

items.title: AI槓桿融資遇冷！10月僅50億美元、全來自同一家 大摩示警新雲端債務風險
items.title_en: AI Leveraged Financing Cools Off! Only $5 B Issued in October, All From One Borrower; Morgan Stanley Warns of New Cloud Debt Risks
paras: AI槓桿融資遇冷，10月發行規模僅50億美元，且全數來自單一借款人。摩根士丹利警告，融資成本攀升與建設延誤風險，將使年底前發行活動持續低迷、新交易門檻顯著抬高，資料中心及「新雲」業者債務波動恐進一步加劇。
這筆50億美元融資全數來自Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd.。該公司透過定期貸款籌資，發行殖利率超過11%。在融資成本走高之際，大摩認為，建設進度的不確定性也將壓抑市場活躍度，使新交易更難推進。
摩根士丹利策略師指出，美國期中選舉過後，仰賴高收益債與槓桿貸款的企業，取得電力配套及新建案審批時，可能遭遇更多阻礙。這些障礙可能影響計畫推進，進而改變企業的投資步調與規模，也使相關融資發行在年底前持續受限。
面對更高的融資門檻，開發商若要順利籌資，可能必須提供更有利於貸方的條件。大摩表示，開發商可能需要支付更高溢價，以補償建設風險；也可能須在再融資前償還更多本金，或引進信用條件更好的進駐客戶。
其中，進駐客戶的信用評等將影響融資難度。隨著投資人對新建案的審查日益嚴格，依賴低評等租戶的計畫，籌資挑戰將尤其明顯。開發商能否取得資金，將更取決於交易條件，以及客戶信用是否足以支撐貸方對風險的要求。
大摩同時預期，資料中心建設債券與所謂「新雲業者」（neocloud）發行的債務，波動將會加劇。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(YNDX-US) 等新雲業者主要出租AI晶片使用權，高度依賴外部資金，且營運歷史有限，是報告點出的相關業者。
當投資人有更多機會參與由信用實力較強主體支持的晶片融資計畫，貸方對於保障條款較薄弱的交易，態度也將更加審慎。對需要持續取得外部資金的新雲業者而言，這樣的融資環境將使交易條件與信用保障更受關注。
不過，槓桿融資轉冷之際，AI與資料中心今年累計債務發行規模仍大幅高於去年。摩根士丹利數據顯示，2026年迄今相關發行規模已達6460億美元，約為2025年全年2160億美元的三倍。
展望明年，大摩在期中選舉後，維持對主要雲端業者2027年合計資本支出的預估不變，並預期這些企業將帶動AI相關融資需求上升。
報告一方面警告槓桿融資與新雲債務面臨更嚴格審查，另一方面仍預期大型雲端業者將持續推動明年的籌資需求。
paras_en: AI leveraged financing has cooled, with only $5 billion issued in October, all coming from a single borrower. Morgan Stanley warns that rising financing costs and construction delays will keep issuance activity subdued through year‑end and significantly raise the bar for new deals, potentially amplifying debt volatility for data‑center and “new‑cloud” operators.

The entire $5 billion financing came from Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd., which raised funds via a term loan at a yield exceeding 11%. Morgan Stanley says that as financing costs climb, uncertainty over construction timelines will also dampen market activity, making new transactions harder to advance.

Morgan Stanley strategists note that after the U.S. midterm elections, companies reliant on high‑yield bonds and leveraged loans may face more obstacles when seeking power‑supply approvals and new project permits. These hurdles could slow project progress, alter corporate investment timing and scale, and keep related financing issuances constrained through year‑end.

Facing higher financing thresholds, developers may need to offer more lender‑friendly terms to raise capital. Morgan Stanley says developers might have to pay higher premiums to compensate for construction risk, repay more principal before refinancing, or bring in tenants with stronger credit profiles.

Tenant credit ratings will affect financing difficulty. As investors scrutinize new projects more closely, plans that depend on low‑rated tenants will face especially pronounced fundraising challenges. Whether developers can secure funding will hinge more on deal terms and whether tenant credit can meet lenders’ risk requirements.

Morgan Stanley also expects volatility to increase for data‑center construction bonds and debt issued by so‑called “new‑cloud” players. Companies such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (YNDX‑US), which primarily lease AI‑chip usage rights, are highly dependent on external capital and have limited operating histories, making them focal points in the report.

When investors have more opportunities to back chip‑financing projects supported by stronger credit entities, lenders will become more cautious about deals with weaker protection clauses. For new‑cloud firms that need ongoing external funding, this financing environment will place greater emphasis on transaction terms and credit safeguards.

Nevertheless, even as leveraged financing cools, AI and data‑center debt issuance this year remains far above last year’s levels. Morgan Stanley data show that through 2026, related issuances have reached $646 billion, roughly three times the full‑year $216 billion issued in 2025.

Looking ahead to next year, Morgan Stanley maintains its forecast for total 2027 capital expenditures of major cloud providers unchanged after the midterms, and expects these firms to drive higher AI‑related financing demand.

The report warns that leveraged financing and new‑cloud debt will face stricter scrutiny, yet it still anticipates that large cloud operators will continue to generate financing needs for the coming year.

items.title: 美光自高點重挫36% 外資逆風唱多喊目標價 看漲空間逾140%
items.title_en: Micron Falls Over 36% from Peak, Foreign Investors Still Bullish with Target Price Over 140%
paras: 美光股價已從近期高點回跌超過三成，但仍有分析師唱多這家記憶體晶片製造商，看好股價能夠完全收復失土、甚至進一步上漲。
美光周二(10日)下跌1.1%，收在每股725.11美元，自10月1日以來已下跌36%。這波跌勢主因是市場擔憂民主黨在期中選舉獲勝後，可能放緩人工智慧(AI)資料中心建設，進而衝擊AI伺服器的記憶體需求。
KeyBanc分析師John Vinh周一重申美光(MU-US)目標價為1,750美元，代表他看好目前股價仍有約140%的上漲空間。

雲端運算成長回溫 傳統伺服器需求也轉強

Vinh認為，最新的雲端運算成長數據對美光及其他晶片股而言是利多。10月數據顯示，雲端運算成長率月增2%，較去年同期成長12%。他的解讀是，這些數據顯示「傳統伺服器成長強勁回歸」。
Vinh一直看好美光，上個月才把美光列為半導體產業中自己最看好的投資標的之一。他當時說，第4季DRAM價格預估將較前一季上漲15%至20%，而Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google也正考慮將長期供應協議延長至2035年。
Vinh的目標價是以美光2028會計年度預估獲利的六倍本益比計算而得，他指出，美光目前股價只有市場對其2027會計年度獲利共識預估的四倍本益比，低於過去三年九倍的中位數。
雖然對記憶體產業持懷疑態度的人士主張，不應以本益比看待記憶體公司，理由是在景氣循環獲利高峰期，這類公司的本益比往往看起來特別便宜。對此Vinh及其他樂觀派分析師認為，人工智慧(AI)熱潮可望讓美光的強勁獲利至少再延續18個月，代表目前股價實在便宜到不容忽視。
paras_en: Micron’s stock has fallen more than 30% from its recent highs, yet some analysts remain bullish on the memory‑chip maker, expecting the shares to fully recover and even rise further.

On Tuesday (10th), Micron fell 1.1% to close at $725.11 per share, a 36% decline since October 1. The drop is largely driven by market concerns that a Democratic win in the midterm elections could slow AI data‑center construction, thereby hurting memory demand for AI servers.
KeyBanc analyst John Vinh reiterated Micron’s (MU‑US) target price of $1,750 on Monday, indicating he sees about 140% upside from the current price.

Vinh believes the latest cloud‑computing growth data is a boon for Micron and other chip stocks. October data showed cloud growth at 2% month‑on‑month, up 12% from the same period last year, which he interprets as a strong rebound in traditional server demand.

Vinh has long been bullish on Micron, having named it one of his top semiconductor picks last month. He noted that fourth‑quarter DRAM prices are expected to rise 15%–20% from the previous quarter, and that Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Google is considering extending its long‑term supply agreement to 2035.

His target price is based on a six‑times earnings multiple of Micron’s projected 2028 fiscal year earnings; he points out that the current price reflects only a four‑times multiple of the consensus 2027 earnings estimate, below the three‑year median of nine times.

While skeptics argue that P/E ratios are not appropriate for memory companies—since their ratios can look cheap during profit peaks of the business cycle—Vinh and other optimists contend that the AI boom could sustain Micron’s strong earnings for at least 18 more months, making the current price uncomfortably cheap.

items.title: 小三黃樂有多美？舊識曝：看到會被電到 好像被勾了魂
items.title_en: How Beautiful Is Alice Huang, Nvidia's Mistress? Former Acquaintance Reveals She Can Shock You With Her Charm
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳坦承婚外情，小三黃樂（Alice Huang）瞬間成為全球關注焦點。
據《8視界新聞網》10日（周二）報導，一名早年在香港認識黃樂的知情人士透露，學生時期的黃樂開朗健談，極度自信，擁有很強社交和公關能力，談戀愛從不低調。
上述消息人士最後一次與黃樂聯繫是在2008年前後，因此，她只能講述當年認識的黃樂，對她畢業後經歷，以及目前受到關注相關指控並不了解。
現年50歲知情人士說，她大約在2007年至2008年間於香港認識黃樂。她憶述，黃樂大概也是在2008年從香港浸會大學碩士班畢業。
「她是很開朗、很活潑、很open（開放）的一個人，也非常健談。」在她印象中，黃樂最大特點之一就是超有自信。
消息人士說，黃樂當年英語不算好，「但她非常非常非常有自信，所以就算講的是破英語，她也敢講。」
她也形容黃樂是她當時認識的人當中公關能力最出色的女生之一。
近期有媒體形容黃樂擁有一定「氣場」，知情人士對此並未否認，「她笑起來很甜，男孩子看到會被電到，好像被勾了魂」。
知情人士表示，黃樂來自相當富裕的家庭。根據她當年從黃樂聽到的說法，黃父在湖南經商，當時是當地數一數二的商人。
除了外向和自信，消息人士對黃樂在感情方面的印象也相當深刻。
她形容大學時期的黃樂談戀愛十分高調，不會刻意隱藏感情狀態，「她談戀愛就是要讓全世界知道」。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, instantly thrusting his mistress Alice Huang into global spotlight.

According to 8Vision News on Tuesday, a former acquaintance who met Huang in Hong Kong early in her life described her as outgoing, talkative, extremely confident, with strong social and PR skills, and never shy about romance.
The source last contacted Huang around 2008, so she can only speak about the Huang she met then, her post-graduation life, and the current allegations she is unaware of.
The 50‑year‑old source recalled meeting Huang in Hong Kong between 2007 and 2008, noting that Huang likely graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University’s master’s program in 2008.
"She was very cheerful, lively, open, and very talkative," the source said, adding that one of Huang’s biggest traits was her confidence.
The source added that Huang’s English was not great, "but she was so confident that even with broken English she dared to speak."
She also described Huang as one of the most skilled PR people among those she knew at the time.
Recently, media have described Huang as having a certain "presence," which the source did not deny, saying, "When she smiles, it’s sweet; boys feel shocked, as if they’re enchanted."
The source said Huang comes from a very affluent family. According to Huang’s own words, her father was a top businessman in Hunan at the time.
Beyond her extroversion and confidence, the source had a strong impression of Huang’s romantic life.
She described university‑era Huang as very flamboyant in love, never hiding her relationship status, "She wanted the whole world to know she was in love."

items.title: 美中建立超級智慧對話機制！貝森特：競爭之餘也須防範AI風險 下周川習會登場
items.title_en: U.S. and China Set Up Super‑Intelligence Dialogue Mechanism; Bessent: Competition Must Be Paired With AI Risk Management, Next Week’s Trump‑Xi Meeting Looms
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(10日)表示，美國與中國在合作防範人工智慧(AI)風險的同時，也持續彼此競爭，雙方不應對彼此的分歧抱持「不切實際的幻想」。
貝森特在紐約向美中關係全國委員會發表演說，根據事先準備好的講稿，他表示美中兩國政府已建立一項針對「超級智慧」(super intelligence，SI)的新對話機制，目標是防範「共同面臨的風險」，並避免「兩種體制之間產生誤解」。
貝森特表示，這項機制將讓雙方交流先進模型發布前的測試「最佳實務」，並確保「人類判斷始終牢牢掌控這項技術」。他預期，雙方也會在涉及SI模型的重大事件發生時，互相通報。
不過，貝森特並未承諾限制這項技術的發展。北京與華盛頓目前仍陷入激烈競爭，都希望在AI領域取得全球主導地位。
川普政府大致上仍反對加強限制AI發展，擔心此舉會讓美國失去對中國的競爭優勢。不過美國總統川普近期已釋出訊號，表示對設立監管防護措施持較開放態度。
川普在周日播出的CBS訪問中表示：「我不反對設置防護措施。」但他也說，不希望監管規定讓美國在競爭中「大幅落後中國」，並表示中國並沒有這類限制。
中國外交部今年9月曾駁斥放緩前沿AI模型發展的呼籲，表示散布恐懼與對抗只會干擾全球AI治理。與北京觀點密切一致的智庫「中國與全球化智庫」(CCG)創辦人王輝耀(Huiyao Wang)上月則表示，美中會談應該「正視AI風險，並共同管理這些風險」。

美中9月同意啟動AI對話 川習會下周登場

在中國國家主席習近平9月訪問期間，華盛頓與北京同意啟動AI對話並建立溝通管道，以協助化解重大事件。兩國領袖預定下周第三度會晤，貝森特也將隨行，會談將於11月18-19日舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)領袖峰會期間進行。
貝森特周二在演說中表示，隨著這項技術持續進步，兩國必須展現如何「調和競爭需求與領導責任」。他補充說：「我們的利益不會總是一致，對每項挑戰的應對方式也不會總是相同。」
美國今年6月曾短暫禁止外國人士使用Anthropic的Mythos與Fable 5模型，數周後才恢復使用權。美國政府也已限制向北京出口最先進晶片，並指控中國開發者透過美方所稱的工業規模蒸餾技術，複製美國AI模型。
中國駐美大使謝鋒在當天的晚宴上表示，兩國共同努力對於處理全球衝突熱點，以及「改善AI治理」等議題「不可或缺」。他說，合作「未必能解決所有挑戰」，但「沒有合作，就無法解決任何挑戰」。

黃仁勳下周是否隨團訪中受矚

這場活動舉行之際，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與一名疑為中國間諜的女性發生婚外情，正引發爭議。這名億萬富豪科技高層今年5月曾隨川普代表團訪問北京，9月也受邀出席在華盛頓舉行的國宴。
目前不清楚黃仁勳是否出席下周將舉行的峰會。根據《南華早報》(South China Morning Post)報導，其他可能隨川普下周訪中的企業領袖，則包括特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克，以及萬事達卡(MA-US)執行長Michael Miebach。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday the 10th that while the United States and China are cooperating to guard against artificial‑intelligence (AI) risks, they continue to compete with each other and should not cling to "unrealistic fantasies" about their differences.

Speaking to the National Committee on U.S.–China Relations in New York, Bessent said, according to a prepared script, that the two governments have established a new dialogue mechanism on "super intelligence" (SI) aimed at preventing "shared risks" and avoiding misunderstandings between the two systems.

He explained that the mechanism will let the sides exchange best‑practice testing before advanced models are released and ensure that "human judgment remains firmly in control of the technology." He expects the parties will also notify each other of any major events involving SI models.
However, Bessent did not pledge to curb the development of the technology. Beijing and Washington remain locked in a fierce race, each seeking global leadership in AI.

The Trump administration generally opposes tighter AI restrictions, fearing such moves would erode the U.S. competitive edge over China. Yet President Trump recently signaled a more open stance toward regulatory safeguards.

In a CBS interview aired Sunday, Trump said, "I’m not opposed to putting in safeguards," but added that he does not want regulations to cause the United States to fall "far behind China" in the competition, noting that China has no such limits.

China’s foreign ministry in September rebuffed calls to slow frontier AI model development, saying that spreading fear and confrontation would only hinder global AI governance. Huiyao Wang, founder of the China and Globalization Institute (CCG) and closely aligned with Beijing’s view, said last month that U.S.–China talks should "face AI risks head‑on and manage them together."

During President Xi Jinping’s September visit to China, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue and set up communication channels to help defuse major incidents. The two leaders are slated to meet for the third time next week, with Bessent accompanying them; the talks will take place during the APEC Leaders’ Summit on November 18‑19.

Bessent said in his speech that as the technology advances, the two countries must demonstrate how to "reconcile competitive demands with leadership responsibilities." He added, "Our interests will not always align, and our responses to each challenge will not always be the same."

In June this year the United States briefly banned foreign users from accessing Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable 5 models, restoring access only weeks later. The U.S. government has also limited exports of the most advanced chips to Beijing and accused Chinese developers of using what Washington calls industrial‑scale distillation techniques to replicate U.S. AI models.

Chinese ambassador to the United States Xie Feng told the dinner that joint effort by the two nations is "indispensable" for handling global conflict hotspots and "improving AI governance." He said cooperation may not solve every challenge, but "without cooperation, no challenge can be solved."

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged extramarital affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy has drawn attention as the event unfolds. The billionaire tech executive visited Beijing with a Trump delegation in May and was invited to a state dinner in Washington in September.

It remains unclear whether Huang will attend next week’s summit. According to the South China Morning Post, other corporate leaders who may travel to China with the Trump delegation include Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk and Mastercard (MA-US) CEO Michael Miebach.

items.title: 211比204險勝！美眾院擋下彈劾案　但新國會明年就任 赫格塞斯政治麻煩遠未結束
paras: 美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)彈劾危機暫時解除，眾議院周二(10日)就彈劾決議舉行程序性投票，最終以211票贊成、204票反對，決定將彈劾決議移交委員會審議，這項程序性決定實際上使彈劾行動陷入停滯，形同在本屆國會任期內予以否決。
彈劾提案由肯塔基州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Thomas Massie在周一(9日)正式提出，共列出8項彈劾條款，指控赫格塞斯犯下多種「重罪與輕罪」，核心聚焦未經國會授權對伊朗發動軍事行動，另涉及在葉門、委內瑞拉及加勒比地區開展軍事行動、違反《戰爭權力決議》、忽視保護平民法定要求等多項指控。
Massie雖屬共和黨，卻長期與總統川普唱反調，公開批評對伊戰事及援助以色列，他在期中選舉黨內初選中敗給川普支持的對手，年底即將卸任，此次提出彈劾被視為向共和黨同僚施壓，要求就罷免這位川普政府最具爭議內閣成員之一表態，投票結果呈現明顯黨派分野，Massie是唯一與民主黨人一同反對推進彈劾的共和黨議員。
川普隨即在社群媒體發文，稱民主黨針對赫格塞斯的彈劾「慘敗」，並痛斥Massie是「一個徹頭徹尾的失敗者」，同時指控民主黨將彈劾當作政治武器、持續「武器化」美國加以濫用。
川普指出，除Massie外，其他共和黨人都投票支持赫格塞斯。他周一在白宮答覆《CNN》記者提問時更力挺赫格塞斯：「我會支持他。他贏了兩場戰爭。他是負責人，我們都贏了。」他還回嗆記者與Massie，稱不應讓此人佔用國會時間。
此次彈劾風波正值共和黨在上周二(3日)期中選舉慘敗餘波之際，黨內將失利部分歸咎於伊朗戰事拖累。
赫格塞斯周二開記者會堅稱，彈劾是「由政策分歧驅動的政治鬧劇」，強調自己實施的是合法且成功的軍事行動，並將此舉與川普先前兩度遭彈劾相提並論，表示「這一套對我沒用」。
然而，隨著民主黨重奪參眾兩院控制權，新國會明年就任後勢必掀起更大規模調查，赫格塞斯的麻煩恐怕遠未結束。

items.title: APEC工商領導人峰會開幕在即 預計超2000人參會
items.title_en: APEC Business Leaders Summit Opening Soon, Over 2,000 Expected to Attend
paras: 今年亞太經合組織(APEC)工商領導人峰會將於11月17日至18日在深圳登場，主題為「共促繁榮，共贏未來」。據主辦單位中國貿促會透露，參會人數預計超過2,000人，21個APEC經濟體及英、法、德等域外國家企業代表均踴躍參與。
包含Google(GOOGL-US)、波音(BA-US)、瑞銀及正大集團等全球500強企業皆已提交申請；大會特別設置包含中文、英語、西班牙語、泰語與越南語等8種語言的同步口譯，聚焦數位經濟、人工智慧與綠色低碳等前沿領域合作。
緊接著於11月18日至19日舉行的是第33次APEC領袖峰會，主題定為「建設亞太共同體，促進共同繁榮」，聚焦開放、創新與合作。這是中國繼2001年上海、2014年北京後，時隔12年第三次擔任東道主。
媒體《財經》指出，從上海的「開放融入」、北京的「合作共建」到深圳的「創新探索」，體現了中國對外開放層級的不斷深化。
除了經濟議題外，峰會場邊的大國互動同樣為全球焦點。針對中美俄三方會晤，難免引發「大國共治」並漠視小國權益的疑慮，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基強調，絕不希望局勢演變成重新畫分勢力範圍的「雅爾達2.0」。
上海復旦大學中美關係專家信強補充，雅爾達秘密協議是中國深刻的大國政治歷史教訓。德國總統史坦邁爾透露，習近平已明確表態三國領導人不會在深圳討論烏克蘭命運，烏克蘭問題必須有歐洲參與談判。復旦大學美國研究中心副主任宋國友則認為，中方僅會將自身定位為中立的對話促進者與見證者。
paras_en: This year the APEC Business Leaders Summit will be held in Shenzhen on November 17-18, with the theme “Promoting Prosperity Together, Winning the Future Together.” According to the organizer, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade, more than 2,000 participants are expected, with representatives from the 21 APEC economies as well as companies from outside the region such as the United Kingdom, France and Germany taking part enthusiastically.

Global 500 companies including Google (GOOGL-US), Boeing (BA-US), UBS and the Charoen Pokphand Group have already submitted applications; the conference will feature simultaneous interpretation in eight languages—Chinese, English, Spanish, Thai, Vietnamese and others—focusing on cooperation in frontier areas such as the digital economy, artificial intelligence and green low‑carbon initiatives.

Immediately following, the 33rd APEC Leaders’ Summit will take place on November 18-19, with the theme “Building an Asia‑Pacific Community and Promoting Shared Prosperity,” emphasizing openness, innovation and cooperation. This marks China’s third time hosting the summit after Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014, a 12‑year gap.

The media outlet Caijing noted that the progression from Shanghai’s “Open Integration,” Beijing’s “Cooperative Construction,” to Shenzhen’s “Innovative Exploration” reflects the deepening level of China’s external openness.

Beyond economic issues, the interaction among major powers on the sidelines of the summit is also a global focus. The prospect of a trilateral meeting of China, the United States and Russia raises concerns about “great‑power governance” that could overlook the interests of smaller nations; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stressed that he does not want the situation to evolve into a new “Yalta 2.0” that redraws spheres of influence.

Fudan University expert on China‑U.S. relations Xin Qiang added that the secret Yalta agreements serve as a profound lesson in great‑power politics for China. German President Frank‑Walter Steinmeier disclosed that Xi Jinping has made it clear that the three leaders will not discuss Ukraine’s fate in Shenzhen and that the Ukraine issue must involve European participation in negotiations. Song Guoyou, deputy director of Fudan’s Center for American Studies, said China will position itself only as a neutral facilitator and witness of dialogue.

items.title: 福斯收購Roku後啟動80億美元債券發行！最長年期達40年
items.title_en: Fox Launches $8 Billion Bond Issuance After Acquiring Roku, Longest Maturity 40 Years
paras: 美國媒體公司福斯(FOX-US) 完成以220億美元收購串流平台Roku(ROKU-US) 後，隨即啟動大規模債券籌資，計畫透過發行投資級債券募集約80億美元，以償還部分收購融資。
根據《彭博》周二（10日）引述知情人士報導，福斯已開始分七批發行投資級債券，期限從3年至40年不等。其中，期限最長的債券發行利率，較美國公債殖利率高出約2.25個百分點。
此次債券發行由摩根士丹利(MS-US) 主導承銷，花旗集團(C-US) 、德意志銀行(DB-US) 、高盛集團(GS-US) 及摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 也參與其中。募集資金將用於償還一筆84億美元的過橋貸款，這筆貸款先前用於支應收購Roku的部分現金對價。
福斯與Roku的收購案於今年6月宣布，採現金加股票方式支付，並於上周五（6日）完成交易。
透過這筆收購，福斯將能接觸使用Roku平台的逾1億個家庭，有助於這家主要仰賴有線電視業務的媒體公司擴大數位觀眾規模，並提升廣告投放的精準度。
《彭博》報導另指出，福斯預計在收購完成後的兩年內，每年節省約4億美元成本。
paras_en: After completing its $22 billion acquisition of streaming platform Roku (ROKU-US), U.S. media company Fox (FOX-US) immediately kicked off a large‑scale bond financing, planning to raise about $8 billion by issuing investment‑grade bonds to repay part of the acquisition financing.

According to Bloomberg on Tuesday (the 10th), citing sources familiar with the matter, Fox has begun issuing investment‑grade bonds in seven tranches with maturities ranging from 3 to 40 years. The longest‑dated bonds carry a yield roughly 2.25 percentage points above the U.S. Treasury rate.

The bond offering is led by Morgan Stanley (MS-US) as bookrunner, with participation from Citigroup (C-US), Deutsche Bank (DB-US), Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US). The proceeds will be used to repay an $8.4 billion bridge loan that was previously drawn to fund part of the cash consideration for the Roku acquisition.
Fox and Roku announced the acquisition in June of this year, using a mix of cash and stock, and completed the transaction last Friday (the 6th).

Through the deal, Fox will gain access to more than 100 million households that use the Roku platform, helping the media company—traditionally reliant on cable TV—to expand its digital audience and improve the precision of its advertising targeting.
Bloomberg also reported that Fox expects to save about $400 million in costs each year for the two years following the completion of the acquisition.

items.title: 一艘飛艇覆蓋範圍相當於500座基地台！日本軟銀2027年啟動HAPS商轉台灣供應鏈能有新商機？
items.title_en: A Single Airship Covers an Area Equivalent to 500 Ground Base Stations! SoftBank Japan to Launch HAPS Commercial Service in 2027 – New Opportunities for Taiwan Supply Chain?
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本電信大廠軟銀SoftBank(9434-JP)開始把行動通訊基地台搬到天空。公司與美國航太業者Sceye簽署五年服務協議，計畫在日本部署高空通訊飛艇機隊，目標2027年開始提供商業服務。Sceye也宣布開始推動高空平台全面量產，準備從過去的通訊試驗轉向商業機隊部署。
這種技術稱為高空平台站(HAPS)，利用太陽能飛艇或無人機，在距離地面約20公里的平流層搭載行動基地台設備，直接向地面手機提供訊號。Sceye今年在日本進行測試時，飛艇實際運作高度約為16.5公里。
根據Sceye的規劃，一艘飛艇在完整部署後，訊號覆蓋面積約相當於500座地面基地台。對電信商來說，過去要把網路延伸至偏遠山區、離島或人口稀少地區，必須興建基地台、鋪設光纖及配置電力設施，未來則有機會透過高空平台，直接提供大範圍的行動通訊服務。不過，500座基地台指的是覆蓋面積，不代表通訊容量相同，實際效果仍取決於用戶數量、頻譜及網路負載。
因此，HAPS短期較適合補足偏遠地區與災害通訊需求，而非全面取代人口密集區域的地面基地台。
日本之所以積極發展這項技術，也與防災需求有關。當地震、颱風造成地面基地台、光纖或供電設施損壞時，高空平台若能及時部署，就有機會在地面網路修復前提供緊急通訊服務。相較於重新興建基地台，這種不必大量依賴當地地面設施的通訊方式，具有不同的應用價值。
但HAPS過去一直面臨商業化困難。雖然飛艇可以利用太陽能長時間飛行，真正要成為電信基礎設施，還必須在平流層持續維持指定位置，並確保通訊設備全天候正常運作。除了飛行控制，機上供電、儲能及設備重量都是限制。
軟銀今年9月完成的通訊試驗，讓商轉計畫向前推進。
Sceye的飛艇於8月9日從美國新墨西哥州起飛，13天後抵達日本，在日本上空進行超過七天的通訊測試，隨後返回美國。整趟任務歷時約30天，飛行距離接近3萬公里。
測試期間，軟銀成功驗證一般手機直接連線、影像傳輸、緊急通訊及無人機控制等功能，並將行動核心網路與網頁伺服器裝設在飛艇上，讓部分資料不必傳回地面雲端，就能直接在高空處理。
測試結果顯示，機上運算的平均往返延遲為68毫秒，較透過雲端處理降低超過40%。這代表高空平台未來除了提供手機訊號，也可能執行部分即時影像分析、無人機控制及低功耗AI推論工作，擴大原本單純通訊中繼的功能。
完成測試後，軟銀進一步與Sceye簽下五年服務合約，由Sceye負責飛艇製造、發射與營運。初期大部分機隊將用於日本行動寬頻覆蓋，部分則規劃建立高空自由空間光通訊(FSO)網路。
這份合約最值得關注的地方，是電信商開始改變採購方式。過去主要購買基地台與相關設備，再自行建置網路；未來若HAPS商業模式成熟，電信商可以直接向高空平台業者採購通訊覆蓋與網路容量服務，將部分設備建置及營運工作交由平台供應商負責。
因此，HAPS未來的市場價值不只來自飛行器銷售，也可能包含長期機隊營運、通訊容量租賃及網路服務收入。過去全球HAPS硬體市場每年約6,500萬至7,500萬美元的估計，並未完整涵蓋這類服務收入，未必能反映商轉後的整體市場規模。
Sceye本身也正朝這個方向發展。這家成立於2014年的美國航太公司，總部位於新墨西哥州，專門開發利用氦氣浮力運作的太陽能飛艇，機體長度約65公尺。公司透過引進不同地區的策略投資人，尋找未來的商業服務市場。
包括拉丁美洲電信集團América Móvil、沙烏地阿拉伯Mawarid Holding，以及日本軟銀，都先後參與Sceye募資。其中軟銀於2025年入股，2026年便簽下五年機隊合約。依先前募資資料，Sceye估值約5.25億美元，但目前尚未公布新的估值、實際量產產能或日本合約總金額。
日本另一大電信業者NTT Docomo也在發展HAPS。該陣營透過HAPS JAPAN，承諾向空中巴士Airbus旗下AALTO投資最多1億美元，採用Zephyr太陽能固定翼無人機。Zephyr已創下連續飛行超過67天的紀錄，但原訂2026年商轉的計畫尚未實現，今年10月仍持續與合作夥伴研究平流層無線網路架構與AI網路控制。
兩大陣營的技術不同，也會影響後續零組件需求。Zephyr透過固定翼與太陽能電池維持飛行，對重量及發電效率要求嚴格；Sceye則使用氦氣飛艇，利用浮力支撐機體，具有不同的酬載配置空間。不過，無論採取哪一種設計，要增加通訊容量，都需要提高天線效率及機上供電能力。
其中，電力供應是HAPS擴大應用的主要限制。高空平台白天利用太陽能發電，同時供應飛行、通訊與運算設備，夜間則仰賴電池維持運作。當平台需要搭載更多天線或運算設備，耗電量也會增加，因此高效率太陽能電池、輕量化材料及低功耗通訊設備，將直接影響可提供的服務容量。
日本材料廠已開始投入相關開發。軟銀今年4月與TOPPAN Holdings(7911-JP)宣布共同開發HAPS固定翼機體所需的輕量化蒙皮材料，目標提高耐低溫、抗紫外線及耐久性能，並規劃於2028會計年度前建立量產技術，為後續商業部署做準備。
台灣供應鏈則有機會從通訊天線、太陽能電池及光學鍍膜切入。
其中，稜研科技(7812-TW)已切入日本HAPS供應鏈，其Q頻段通訊解決方案獲選為日本HAPS專案供應商，地面閘道系統已完成交付並進入場域驗證。公司也布局電子掃描陣列天線，並與美國Comtech合作開發多軌道通訊設備，可依不同區域的需求調整訊號方向與通訊容量，未來有機會爭取更多高空通訊訂單。
太陽能電池方面，宏捷科(8086-TW)今年第一季已開始量產出貨HAPS用砷化鎵太陽能電池。這類電池轉換效率較高，適合對重量與供電能力要求嚴格的高空平台，隨著機上通訊設備增加，對高效率電池的需求也可能跟著提高。
統新(6426-TW)則具備光學抗反射鍍膜技術，可減少光線反射損失，提高太陽能電池的光吸收效率。公司目前已供應低軌衛星使用的雷射通訊接收端濾光片及III-V族太陽能電池鍍膜，累積太空應用實績。由於HAPS同樣高度依賴太陽能供電，相關鍍膜技術未來也有機會延伸至高空平台應用，但目前尚未有明確的HAPS訂單。
日本HAPS產業正從技術試驗走向商業部署，但首批機隊數量及設備採購規模尚小，短期對台灣供應鏈的營收貢獻仍低。不過，對稜研這類營收基期較小、正從產品驗證走向量產的廠商來說，即使初期訂單金額不大，也可能帶來相對明顯的營收成長。隨著軟銀計畫2027年啟動商轉，台灣廠商能否將現有技術與專案實績轉為持續出貨的訂單，將是後續觀察重點。
