paras_en: November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japanese telecom giant SoftBank (9434-JP) is moving mobile communication base stations to the sky. The company signed a five‑year service agreement with U.S. aerospace firm Sceye, planning to deploy a fleet of high‑altitude communication airships in Japan, with commercial service slated to begin in 2027. Sceye also announced it will start full‑scale production of high‑altitude platforms, shifting from past communication trials to commercial fleet deployment.

This technology is called High‑Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) and uses solar‑powered airships or drones operating in the stratosphere about 20 km above the ground, carrying mobile base‑station equipment to provide signal directly to handheld devices. During tests in Japan this year, Sceye’s airship operated at an altitude of roughly 16.5 km.

According to Sceye’s plan, a fully deployed airship would cover an area equivalent to about 500 ground base stations. For telecom operators, extending networks to remote mountainous areas, islands or sparsely populated regions now requires building base stations, laying fiber and installing power infrastructure; in the future, high‑altitude platforms could provide wide‑area mobile service directly. However, the “500 base stations” figure refers to coverage area, not to communication capacity, which still depends on user numbers, spectrum and network load.

Thus, HAPS is more suitable in the short term for supplementing coverage in remote areas and disaster‑relief communications rather than fully replacing ground base stations in densely populated zones.

Japan’s push for this technology is also driven by disaster‑response needs. When earthquakes or typhoons damage ground base stations, fiber or power facilities, a quickly deployed high‑altitude platform could provide emergency communications before terrestrial networks are restored. Compared with rebuilding ground stations, this approach, which does not heavily rely on local infrastructure, offers distinct value.

Nevertheless, HAPS has long faced commercialization challenges. Although airships can fly for extended periods using solar power, to serve as telecom infrastructure they must maintain a fixed position in the stratosphere and keep communication equipment operating around the clock. Flight control, onboard power, energy storage and payload weight are all limiting factors.
SoftBank’s communication trial completed in September this year moved the commercial rollout plan forward.

Sceye’s airship took off from New Mexico, USA on August 9, flew for 13 days to Japan, conducted more than seven days of communication tests over Japanese airspace, then returned to the U.S. The entire mission lasted about 30 days and covered nearly 30,000 km.

During the test, SoftBank successfully verified functions such as direct mobile phone connection, video transmission, emergency communications and drone control, and installed the mobile core network and web server on the airship so that some data could be processed aloft without being sent to ground cloud servers.

Test results showed the average round‑trip latency of onboard computing was 68 ms, more than 40 % lower than cloud‑based processing. This indicates that future high‑altitude platforms could not only provide mobile signal but also perform real‑time video analysis, drone control and low‑power AI inference, expanding beyond simple signal relay.

After the test, SoftBank signed a five‑year service contract with Sceye, under which Sceye will handle airship manufacturing, launch and operation. Most of the initial fleet will be used for mobile broadband coverage in Japan, with part of the fleet planned to establish a high‑altitude free‑space optical (FSO) network.

The most noteworthy aspect of the contract is the shift in how telecom operators procure equipment. Historically they bought base stations and related gear and built networks themselves; if the HAPS business model matures, operators could purchase coverage and capacity services directly from platform providers, outsourcing much of the equipment deployment and operation.

Therefore, the future market value of HAPS comes not only from aircraft sales but also from long‑term fleet operation, capacity leasing and network service revenue. Past estimates of the global HAPS hardware market at $65‑75 million per year did not fully capture these service revenues and may underestimate the total market after commercialization.

Sceye itself is moving in this direction. The U.S. aerospace company, founded in 2014 and based in New Mexico, develops solar‑powered airships that float using helium, with a length of about 65 m. It seeks strategic investors from various regions to tap future commercial service markets.

Investors such as Latin American telecom group América Móvil, Saudi Arabia’s Mawarid Holding and Japan’s SoftBank have participated in Sceye’s fundraising. SoftBank invested in 2025 and signed the five‑year fleet contract in 2026. Earlier fundraising valued Sceye at roughly $525 million, but no updated valuation, production capacity or total contract amount for Japan has been disclosed.

Japan’s other major telecom operator NTT Docomo is also developing HAPS. Through HAPS JAPAN, it pledged up to $100 million to Airbus’s AALTO subsidiary, using the Zephyr solar‑powered fixed‑wing UAV. Zephyr set a record of over 67 days of continuous flight, but the planned 2026 commercial launch has not materialized; in October this year the project continued researching stratospheric wireless architecture and AI network control with partners.

The two camps use different technologies, affecting downstream component demand. Zephyr relies on a fixed wing and solar cells, imposing strict weight and power‑generation requirements; Sceye uses a helium‑filled airship whose buoyancy supports the structure, offering different payload configurations. Regardless of design, increasing communication capacity requires higher‑efficiency antennas and greater onboard power.

Power supply is the main constraint on expanding HAPS applications. During daylight the platform generates solar power to run flight, communication and computing systems; at night it depends on batteries. Adding more antennas or compute hardware raises power consumption, so high‑efficiency solar cells, lightweight materials and low‑power communication gear directly affect the service capacity that can be offered.

Japanese material firms have begun related development. In April SoftBank and TOPPAN Holdings (7911-JP) announced a joint effort to develop lightweight skin material for HAPS fixed‑wing aircraft, aiming to improve low‑temperature tolerance, UV resistance and durability, with mass‑production technology targeted before fiscal year 2028 to prepare for commercial deployment.
Taiwan’s supply chain could tap into HAPS opportunities through communication antennas, solar cells and optical coatings.

Among them, LING‑YEN Technology (7812‑TW) has entered the Japanese HAPS supply chain; its Q‑band communication solution was selected for a Japanese HAPS project, with the ground gateway system delivered and now undergoing field verification. The company is also developing electronic‑scan array antennas and, together with U.S. firm Comtech, a multi‑band communication device that can adjust signal direction and capacity per region, positioning it for future high‑altitude communication orders.

In solar‑cell technology, Hong‑Jie Technology (8086‑TW) began mass production and shipment of gallium‑arsenide solar cells for HAPS in Q1 2024. These high‑efficiency cells suit the strict weight and power needs of high‑altitude platforms, and demand is likely to rise as onboard communication equipment expands.

Tong‑Xin (6426‑TW) possesses optical anti‑reflection coating technology that reduces light loss and boosts solar‑cell absorption efficiency. The firm already supplies laser‑communication filters and III‑V solar‑cell coatings for low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, building a space‑application track record. Because HAPS heavily rely on solar power, such coating tech could extend to high‑altitude platforms, though no concrete HAPS orders have been received yet.

Japan’s HAPS industry is moving from technical trials to commercial deployment, but the initial fleet size and equipment procurement volumes are still modest, so short‑term revenue impact on Taiwan’s supply chain remains low. However, for companies like LING‑YEN with relatively small baseline revenues that are transitioning from product validation to mass production, even modest early orders could drive noticeable revenue growth. As SoftBank plans to start commercial service in 2027, whether Taiwanese firms can turn existing technology and project experience into sustained shipments will be a key watch point.

items.title: 51個月首見！特斯拉中國10月銷量暴跌66.1%至8817輛　Model Y從銷量居首跌至66名
items.title_en: First Drop in 51 Months! Tesla China October Sales Plummet 66.1% to 8,817 Units, Model Y Falls from Top Spot to 66th
paras: 根據懂車帝排行榜數據，特斯拉10月在中國銷量合計僅8817輛，其中Model Y零售7807輛，排名自9月第1位暴跌至第66位；Model 3零售1010輛。
相較之下，中國乘聯分會數據顯示，特斯拉中國10月批發銷量達67829輛，年增10.3%、月減28.88%，創今年2月來最低，零售與批發數據出現顯著落差。
《新浪網》報導，特斯拉上海超級工廠每季前兩個月優先供應海外市場，導致中國國內車源緊縮，是季度初零售波動的主因，但上月零售跌破萬輛關卡，距離上次已時隔51個月，實屬罕見。更深層原因在於9月促銷透支需求，當月Model 3現車直降5000元(人民幣，下同)、Model Y優惠1萬元，刺激大量潛在用戶集中下單，推升9月零售至6.48萬輛的年內高點，但也預支10月買氣。
產品線單薄亦是隱憂。自在中國生產以來，特斯拉在中國僅銷售Model 3與Model Y兩款車型，儘管進行過改款，但更新幅度有限。面對中國新能源車廠在智慧化、座艙體驗與定價策略上的強勢競爭，消費者可選品牌增多，「買車買品牌」的觀念逐漸淡化，特斯拉傳統優勢不再具備絕對吸引力。
中國車市環境同樣嚴峻。根據乘聯分會數據顯示，10月中國國內乘用車零售164.3萬輛，年減27.1%，今年前10月累計零售年減22.3%，存量市場競爭加劇。今年前9月，特斯拉在中國累計零售38.11萬輛，年減11.93%，6月至9月連4月呈年減走勢。
特斯拉品牌認知度猶存，Model Y市場表現仍有目共睹，但在競爭產品林立、內卷激烈的市場中，產品力與品牌吸引力能否持續留住消費者，將決定特斯拉在中國的基本盤的穩固與否。推出全新產品尋求增量，已是當務之急。
paras_en: According to data from the Dongchedi ranking, Tesla sold only 8,817 vehicles in China in October, with 7,807 Model Y units sold at retail. The Model Y’s ranking tumbled from first place in September to 66th, while Model 3 retail sales were 1,010 units.

In contrast, data from the China Passenger Car Association shows Tesla’s wholesale sales in China reached 67,829 units in October, up 10.3% year‑on‑year but down 28.88% month‑on‑month, marking the lowest level since February this year and highlighting a sharp gap between retail and wholesale figures.

Sina News reported that Tesla’s Shanghai Gigafactory prioritises overseas markets for the first two months of each quarter, tightening domestic supply and causing the early‑quarter retail swing. October’s retail fell below the 10,000‑unit threshold for the first time in 51 months, a rare occurrence. A deeper cause was the September promotion that over‑drawn demand: Model 3 inventory was discounted by ¥5,000 and Model Y by ¥10,000, prompting a surge of orders that pushed September retail to a yearly high of 64,800 units, but essentially prepaid October’s demand.

A thin product line is also a concern. Since starting local production, Tesla has only offered the Model 3 and Model Y in China. Although facelifts have been introduced, the updates are modest. Facing strong competition from Chinese EV makers on smart features, cabin experience and pricing, consumers now have more brand choices and the “buy the brand” mindset is fading, eroding Tesla’s traditional advantage.

The Chinese car market environment is equally tough. Data from the Passenger Car Association shows that retail sales of passenger cars in China fell to 1.643 million units in October, down 27.1% year‑on‑year, and cumulative retail sales for the first ten months of the year were down 22.3% year‑on‑year, intensifying competition in the mature market. In the first nine months of the year, Tesla’s cumulative retail sales in China were 381,100 units, down 11.93% year‑on‑year, with a year‑on‑year decline observed from June through September.

Tesla’s brand awareness remains, and the Model Y’s market performance is still noticeable, but in a market crowded with competing products and intense internal competition, the ability of its product strength and brand appeal to retain consumers will determine whether Tesla can secure its core base in China. Launching new models to generate incremental growth has become an urgent priority.

items.title: 諾和諾德、禮來「減肥神藥」爆失明危機？美FDA：須加註罕見眼疾警示
items.title_en: Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly 'Weight‑Loss Miracle' Faces Blindness Risk? US FDA: Must Add Rare Eye Disease Warning
paras: 美國食品藥物管理局(FDA) 9日發布最新安全警訊，要求所有 GLP-1 腸抑胃素受體促效劑類藥物，必須在藥品說明書的警示欄位中，加註可能引發罕見眼疾「非動脈性前部缺血性視神經病變」(NAION)的潛在風險。
這類藥物包括諾和諾德(NVO-US)的 Ozempic 與 Wegovy、禮來(LLY-US)的 Mounjaro 與 Zepbound，以及賽諾菲的 Soliqua等，因為被用於降糖、減肥治療，被視為所謂「減肥神藥」。
NAION 是由於供應視神經的血管血流突然減少或阻塞，致使視神經缺氧所引發。其主要症狀為單眼出現突然且無痛的視力減退，嚴重者可能造成永久性失明，且目前尚無有效療法可逆轉視力損傷。
FDA 在分析 126 項臨床試驗、涵蓋逾 13.4 萬名患者的數據後發現，GLP-1 使用者的 NAION 發生率為每 10 萬人年 6.4 例，高於安慰劑或非 GLP-1 降血糖藥物組的 3.8 例，因而認定存在潛在風險。
針對 FDA 的警示，諾和諾德發言人表示，公司「仍認為現有數據並未建立因果關係，對 GLP-1 藥物的效益與風險特徵保持信心」，並強調「患者安全是諾和諾德的首要任務，將持續監控藥品安全性並與全球衛生主管機關合作」。
禮來聲明指出，公司正在「仔細評估此項更新，並將迅速回應 FDA」，同時重申患者安全為其首要考量。
美國眼科學會(AAO)發表聲明強調：「任何增加的風險似乎都很小，且尚未證實這些藥物會直接導致 NAION」，並向患者呼籲，「切勿在未諮詢醫師的情況下擅自停藥；若發現單眼突然出現無痛性視力喪失，應立即就診眼科」。
哈佛醫學院眼科教授Dr. Joseph Rizzo(2024 年相關研究作者之一)指出，先前發現使用司美格魯肽(Semaglutide)者診斷出 NAION 機率較高的研究結果雖然「顯著，但仍屬初步」，未來仍需針對更廣泛多元的人群進行深入研究。
由於糖尿病本身即為 NAION 的已知風險因子，加上高血壓、高膽固醇及吸菸等共病因素，醫療界普遍認為藥物與眼疾之間的確切因果鏈結仍有待進一步釐清。
paras_en: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on the 9th issued a new safety alert requiring that all GLP‑1 receptor agonist drugs include a warning in the prescribing information about the potential risk of a rare eye disease called non‑arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION).

These drugs include Novo Nordisk’s (NVO‑US) Ozempic and Wegovy, Eli Lilly’s (LLY‑US) Mounjaro and Zepbound, as well as Sanofi’s Soliqua, which are used for diabetes control and weight‑loss treatment and are regarded as so‑called “weight‑loss miracle” drugs.

NAION occurs when the blood flow to the optic nerve suddenly decreases or becomes blocked, causing oxygen deprivation of the nerve. Its main symptom is a sudden, painless loss of vision in one eye; severe cases can lead to permanent blindness, and there is currently no effective therapy to reverse the damage.

After analyzing data from 126 clinical trials involving more than 134,000 patients, the FDA found that the incidence of NAION among GLP‑1 users was 6.4 cases per 100,000 person‑years, higher than the 3.8 cases per 100,000 person‑years observed in placebo or non‑GLP‑1 glucose‑lowering drug groups, indicating a potential risk.

In response to the FDA warning, a Novo Nordisk spokesperson said the company “still believes the existing data do not establish a causal relationship, remains confident in the benefit‑risk profile of GLP‑1 drugs,” and emphasized that “patient safety is Novo Nordisk’s top priority, and we will continue to monitor drug safety and work with health authorities worldwide.”
Eli Lilly stated that it is “carefully evaluating this update and will respond to the FDA promptly,” while reiterating that patient safety is its primary concern.

The American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) issued a statement emphasizing that “any increased risk appears to be very small and it has not been proven that these drugs directly cause NAION,” and urged patients “not to stop the medication without consulting a physician; if you experience sudden painless loss of vision in one eye, seek ophthalmic care immediately.”

Harvard Medical School ophthalmology professor Dr. Joseph Rizzo, one of the authors of a 2024 study, noted that earlier findings showing a higher probability of NAION among semaglutide users were “significant but still preliminary,” and that further research in broader, more diverse populations is needed.

Because diabetes itself is a known risk factor for NAION, and comorbidities such as hypertension, high cholesterol and smoking also contribute, the medical community generally believes that the exact causal link between the drugs and the eye disease remains to be clarified.

items.title_en: AI Leveraged Financing Cools Off! Only $5 B Issued in October, All From One Borrower; Morgan Stanley Warns of New Cloud Debt Risks
paras: AI槓桿融資遇冷，10月發行規模僅50億美元，且全數來自單一借款人。摩根士丹利警告，融資成本攀升與建設延誤風險，將使年底前發行活動持續低迷、新交易門檻顯著抬高，資料中心及「新雲」業者債務波動恐進一步加劇。
這筆50億美元融資全數來自Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd.。該公司透過定期貸款籌資，發行殖利率超過11%。在融資成本走高之際，大摩認為，建設進度的不確定性也將壓抑市場活躍度，使新交易更難推進。
摩根士丹利策略師指出，美國期中選舉過後，仰賴高收益債與槓桿貸款的企業，取得電力配套及新建案審批時，可能遭遇更多阻礙。這些障礙可能影響計畫推進，進而改變企業的投資步調與規模，也使相關融資發行在年底前持續受限。
面對更高的融資門檻，開發商若要順利籌資，可能必須提供更有利於貸方的條件。大摩表示，開發商可能需要支付更高溢價，以補償建設風險；也可能須在再融資前償還更多本金，或引進信用條件更好的進駐客戶。
其中，進駐客戶的信用評等將影響融資難度。隨著投資人對新建案的審查日益嚴格，依賴低評等租戶的計畫，籌資挑戰將尤其明顯。開發商能否取得資金，將更取決於交易條件，以及客戶信用是否足以支撐貸方對風險的要求。
大摩同時預期，資料中心建設債券與所謂「新雲業者」（neocloud）發行的債務，波動將會加劇。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(YNDX-US) 等新雲業者主要出租AI晶片使用權，高度依賴外部資金，且營運歷史有限，是報告點出的相關業者。
當投資人有更多機會參與由信用實力較強主體支持的晶片融資計畫，貸方對於保障條款較薄弱的交易，態度也將更加審慎。對需要持續取得外部資金的新雲業者而言，這樣的融資環境將使交易條件與信用保障更受關注。
不過，槓桿融資轉冷之際，AI與資料中心今年累計債務發行規模仍大幅高於去年。摩根士丹利數據顯示，2026年迄今相關發行規模已達6460億美元，約為2025年全年2160億美元的三倍。
展望明年，大摩在期中選舉後，維持對主要雲端業者2027年合計資本支出的預估不變，並預期這些企業將帶動AI相關融資需求上升。
報告一方面警告槓桿融資與新雲債務面臨更嚴格審查，另一方面仍預期大型雲端業者將持續推動明年的籌資需求。
paras_en: AI leveraged financing has cooled, with only $5 billion issued in October, all coming from a single borrower. Morgan Stanley warns that rising financing costs and construction delays will keep issuance activity subdued through year‑end and significantly raise the bar for new deals, potentially amplifying debt volatility for data‑center and “new‑cloud” operators.

The entire $5 billion financing came from Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd., which raised funds via a term loan at a yield exceeding 11%. Morgan Stanley says that as financing costs climb, uncertainty over construction timelines will also dampen market activity, making new transactions harder to advance.

Morgan Stanley strategists note that after the U.S. midterm elections, companies reliant on high‑yield bonds and leveraged loans may face more obstacles when seeking power‑supply approvals and new project permits. These hurdles could slow project progress, alter corporate investment timing and scale, and keep related financing issuances constrained through year‑end.

Facing higher financing thresholds, developers may need to offer more lender‑friendly terms to raise capital. Morgan Stanley says developers might have to pay higher premiums to compensate for construction risk, repay more principal before refinancing, or bring in tenants with stronger credit profiles.

Tenant credit ratings will affect financing difficulty. As investors scrutinize new projects more closely, plans that depend on low‑rated tenants will face especially pronounced fundraising challenges. Whether developers can secure funding will hinge more on deal terms and whether tenant credit can meet lenders’ risk requirements.

Morgan Stanley also expects volatility to increase for data‑center construction bonds and debt issued by so‑called “new‑cloud” players. Companies such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (YNDX‑US), which primarily lease AI‑chip usage rights, are highly dependent on external capital and have limited operating histories, making them focal points in the report.

When investors have more opportunities to back chip‑financing projects supported by stronger credit entities, lenders will become more cautious about deals with weaker protection clauses. For new‑cloud firms that need ongoing external funding, this financing environment will place greater emphasis on transaction terms and credit safeguards.

Nevertheless, even as leveraged financing cools, AI and data‑center debt issuance this year remains far above last year’s levels. Morgan Stanley data show that through 2026, related issuances have reached $646 billion, roughly three times the full‑year $216 billion issued in 2025.

Looking ahead to next year, Morgan Stanley maintains its forecast for total 2027 capital expenditures of major cloud providers unchanged after the midterms, and expects these firms to drive higher AI‑related financing demand.

The report warns that leveraged financing and new‑cloud debt will face stricter scrutiny, yet it still anticipates that large cloud operators will continue to generate financing needs for the coming year.

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”

items.title: 伊朗威脅行動升級！紐時：對伊極限經濟戰引火上身  貝森特搬進軍事基地避險
items.title_en: Iran Threatens to Escalate Actions! NYT: Extreme Economic War on Iran Backfires, Berrens Moves to Military Base for Safety
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，主導對伊朗制裁的美國財長貝森特已搬入軍事基地，因美方官員認為伊朗針對美國現任及前任官員的行動正進入更深入階段。
《紐約時報》引述三位知情人士報導，美國財長貝森特因自8月起主導川普政府對伊朗的極限經濟施壓，成為德黑蘭重點打擊目標，目前已離開華府住所，轉入軍事基地保護。貝森特透過加強制裁與限制貿易路線，試圖切斷伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊的資金來源。
美國財政部發言人強調，他不會因威脅退縮，官員坦言尚不清楚針對貝森特的威脅有多嚴重，但伊朗過往針對特定個人的威脅常有具體行動指向。
報導指出，去年至少6位美國高官也採取類似措施，像是白宮辦公廳主任米勒等，部分威脅甚至與委內瑞拉局勢有關。威脅蔓延也促使美國調整海外部署。美國國務院上月要求中東地區雇員提升警戒並縮編使領館，因懷疑英國一處軍事基地面臨恐攻陰謀，美軍緊急撤走轟炸機。
這場安全風暴根源於2020年美軍擊殺伊朗將領蘇萊曼尼，伊朗隨後將川普列為報復目標。2024年，美國起訴一名伊朗革命衛隊人員涉嫌策劃謀殺川普。拜登政府曾為當年行動團隊成員提供保護，但川普重返白宮後撤銷了這些安排。
川普政府希望透過經濟制裁迫使德黑蘭讓步，避免重啟大規模軍事行動。儘管伊朗經濟萎縮、貨幣貶值，但情報顯示其強硬派決心不惜代價維持政權，單靠施壓能否改變立場仍是未知數。從貝森特轉入基地到中東人員縮編，伊朗的威脅正深刻影響美國各層面的安全佈局。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that U.S. Treasury Secretary Berrens, who leads sanctions against Iran, has moved into a military base because U.S. officials say Iran’s actions against current and former U.S. officials are entering a deeper phase.

The New York Times, citing three insiders, reported that Treasury Secretary Berrens, who has been spearheading the Trump administration’s extreme economic pressure on Iran since August, has become a primary target for Tehran and has left his Washington residence for protection at a military base. Berrens is trying to cut off funding to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps by tightening sanctions and restricting trade routes.

A Treasury Department spokesperson stressed that he will not back down in the face of threats; officials admitted they do not yet know how serious the threat to Berrens is, but noted that Iran’s past threats against specific individuals have often been accompanied by concrete actions.

The report notes that at least six senior U.S. officials took similar steps last year, such as White House Office of Management and Budget director Miller, with some threats linked to the situation in Venezuela. The spreading threats have also prompted the United States to adjust overseas deployments. Last month the State Department ordered Middle‑East staff to increase alert levels and downsize embassies after suspecting a British military base of being the target of a terror plot, prompting U.S. forces to urgently withdraw bombers.

The security storm stems from the 2020 U.S. strike that killed Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani, after which Iran named former President Trump as a retaliation target. In 2024 the United States indicted an IRGC member for allegedly plotting to assassinate Trump. The Biden administration had provided protection for members of the original operation team, but those arrangements were cancelled after Trump returned to the White House.

The Trump administration hoped that economic sanctions would force Tehran to concede and avoid a large‑scale military restart. Although Iran’s economy has contracted and its currency has depreciated, intelligence shows hardliners remain determined to preserve the regime at any cost, leaving it uncertain whether pressure alone can shift their stance. From Berrens’s move to a base to the downsizing of Middle‑East staff, Iran’s threat is profoundly reshaping U.S. security planning across the board.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: US CPI Hot, Fed Governor’s Hawkish Remarks Strengthen Rate‑Hike Expectations, Dollar Rises
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周二(10日)攀高，美國通膨數據比預期火熱，強化了聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.57%，報102.26。
歐元兌美元下跌0.55%，報1.116美元。美元兌日元上漲0.55%，報158.80日元。元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.71%，報0.8252瑞郎。
美國勞工部公布的數據顯示，美國10月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.4%，高於經濟學家預估的月增0.3%。
數據公布後，美元兌一籃子貨幣延續漲勢。通常與Fed利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率也大幅跳升，最新上漲18.44個基點至4.731%。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered Bank) G10外匯研究及北美總體策略全球主管Steve Englander表示，市場對這份數據感到措手不及，因為數據似乎支持Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周二發表的鷹派談話。華勒當時表示，Fed應在下個月升息，以提高短期借貸成本。
Englander說：「華勒的談話如此鷹派，引起市場注意。美元和利率的這波漲勢就是從那時開始的。」
他表示：「CPI數據也偏熱，尤其是通膨似乎相當廣泛，因此市場開始感到擔憂。美國11月3日期中選舉以來，美元走勢大多受到油價交易主導，但現在市場人士開始認為：『我們是不是看錯了重點？真正應該關注的是通膨風險，以及Fed的政策動向。』」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場目前預估Fed 12月升息的機率接近91%。
對貿易情勢與市場情緒較為敏感的澳幣兌美元下跌0.89%，報0.686美元。紐元兌美元下跌0.56%，報0.56美元。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta說：「短期內美元走弱的空間仍然有限。勞動市場展現韌性，加上國內經濟活動穩健，持續支撐美國消費，也降低經濟突然放緩的風險，很難看到年底前持續走貶。」

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Tuesday (the 10th), as US inflation data came in hotter than expected, bolstering the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.57% to 102.26.
The euro fell 0.55% against the dollar to $1.116, the dollar rose 0.55% against the yen to ¥158.80, and the euro gained 0.71% against the Swiss franc to CHF 0.8252.
US Labor Department data showed that the US consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above economists’ forecast of a 0.3% increase.

After the release, the dollar continued its rally against a basket of currencies. The US 2‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves in line with Fed rate expectations, jumped sharply, up 18.44 basis points to 4.731%.

Steve Englander, Global Head of G10 FX Research and North America Macro Strategy at Standard Chartered Bank, said the market was caught off guard by the data because it seemed to support Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s hawkish comments on Tuesday. Waller said the Fed should raise rates next month to lift short‑term borrowing costs.
Englander said, “Waller’s remarks were so hawkish that they grabbed market attention. The dollar and rate rally started from that point.”

He added, “The CPI data was also on the hotter side, especially since inflation appears fairly broad‑based, so the market began to worry. Since the US mid‑term elections on November 3, the dollar’s moves have been largely driven by oil‑price trading, but now market participants are thinking: ‘Did we miss the point? The real focus should be on inflation risk and Fed policy direction.’”
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now estimates a roughly 91% chance of a Fed rate hike in December.
The Australian dollar, which is sensitive to trade conditions and market sentiment, fell 0.89% against the dollar to $0.686, while the New Zealand dollar slipped 0.56% to $0.56.

Karl Schamotta, Chief Market Strategist at Corpay, said, “The short‑term upside for a weaker dollar is still limited. A resilient labour market, together with solid domestic economic activity that continues to support US consumption, reduces the risk of a sudden slowdown, making it hard to see a sustained decline before year‑end.”

items.title: 日本央行會議紀錄顯露鷹派訊號 多位委員支持加快升息至中立利率
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Meeting Minutes Reveal Hawkish Signals, Several Governors Back Faster Rate Hikes to Neutral Level
paras: 日本央行於10月29至30日召開貨幣政策會議，決議將政策利率維持在1.25%的30年高位，但最新公布的「主要意見」摘要顯示，多名審議委員對早期升息展現積極態度。
在會議表決中，被視為鷹派的審議委員高田創提出將利率調升至1.5%左右的提案，雖遭多數否決，而在9月反對升息的淺田統一郎與佐藤綾野兩位委員，本次投票贊成維持現狀。
針對未來貨幣政策走向，日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會上強調，包含12月會議在內，每次會議都會評估是否升息，並指出基調物價通膨率已達到2%的政策目標。
會議紀錄中，有委員主張「不應過度謹慎，應在可行時實施升息」，也有委員表示日本經濟已進入「需加快腳步將政策利率推升至中立利率」的新階段。
一名委員指出，由於先前的升息，寬鬆程度已逐步降低。他補充說，政策利率目前處於日本央行估計的中性利率區間(1.1%-2.5%)內，但應注意未來升息可能抑制經濟成長和潛在通膨的風險。此外，多名委員指出當前金融環境仍屬寬鬆，應在數個月內確認金融情勢後「悠然但迅速」地調整政策。
隨著核心物價穩定成長，金融市場與利率掉期交易預估，日銀於12月再次升息25個基點的機率已高達七至八成。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan held its monetary policy meeting on October 29‑30, deciding to keep the policy rate at a 30‑year high of 1.25%, but the newly released summary of the "Main Opinions" shows that several board members were proactive about earlier rate hikes.

In the vote, hawkish board member Takada Hajime proposed raising the rate to around 1.5%, a motion that was largely rejected, while the two members who opposed a hike in September, Shimada Kazuo and Sato Ayano, voted to maintain the status quo this time.

Regarding the future path of monetary policy, BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo stressed at the post‑meeting press conference that each meeting, including the December session, will assess whether to raise rates, noting that core‑inflation has already hit the 2% target.

The minutes record that some members argued "we should not be overly cautious and should raise rates when feasible," while others said Japan’s economy has entered a new phase "that requires accelerating the push to lift the policy rate to a neutral level."

One member pointed out that, because of previous hikes, the degree of monetary easing has already been gradually reduced. He added that the policy rate now sits within the BOJ’s estimated neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%, but warned that further hikes could curb growth and potential inflation. Several members also noted that the financial environment remains accommodative and that policy should be adjusted "calmly but swiftly" within a few months after confirming financial conditions.
With core prices showing stable growth, financial markets and interest‑rate swap traders estimate a 70‑80% chance that the BOJ will raise rates by another 25 basis points in December.

items.title: 日元明年走勢兩極化！彭博前季預測冠軍估貶170 最新冠軍看升147
items.title_en: Yen's Outlook Next Year Splits: Bloomberg's Prior Quarter Champion Forecasts a 170 Decline, New Champion Sees a 147 Rise
paras: 在歷經多次金融危機與劇烈的匯率波動後，深耕日元市場近30年的外匯專家奈爾·帕克（Neil Parker）再次拋出震撼彈。根據彭博最新的外匯預測排名，這位日元兌美元預測準確率居冠的策略師認為，隨著美日利差逐步收窄，日元明年有望強勁反彈至 147 兌 1 美元。
在看法高度分歧的市場中，帕克屬於最樂觀的陣營之一。他預期日元年底前將升至155日元兌1美元左右，之後進一步走強；上季度的彭博預測冠軍看法則截然相反，認為日元明年將一路走貶至 170 大關。
造成市場預測極端分歧的核心原因，在於對日本央行（BOJ）升息路徑的判斷差異。
帕克預估日本央行將把基準利率從 1.25% 一路調升至至少 2%，甚至上看 2.25%，其緊縮立場遠比市場主流預期更為激進；至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
擔任外匯與支付公司TTT Moneycorp經濟暨市場策略主管的帕克表示：「日本可能成為少數例外，日本銀行確實會履行承諾，將利率調整至與通膨相符的水準。」
日本市場人士對於通膨升溫是否會促使央行加快緊縮，仍存在分歧。日本9月扣除生鮮食品與能源的消費者物價指數年增2.4%，這也是日本銀行密切關注、用來衡量底層通膨的指標。
帕克表示，若增幅升至2.6%或更高，可能促使央行採取更強力措施，加快緊縮步調。不過，他也不確定日本銀行是否會最快在12月就採取行動。
日美緊縮步調的差異，是他預測日元走強的基礎。他表示，兩國利差若再縮小約50個基點，也就是他預期明年年中至下半年可能出現的幅度，或許就足以促使投資人重新調整預期。
他說：「投資人不一定要加碼日本資產，只要降低減碼幅度就夠了。」
日元今年平均匯率約為158日元兌1美元，7月一度貶至163.99，隨後日本與美國當局出手干預。市場劇烈波動考驗著派克的預測，但除非支撐其判斷的經濟基本面改變，否則他不願輕易調整展望。
在建構預測模型時，帕克會將市場對利率與通漲的預期與自身研判進行對照，從中尋找價格錯置所產生的匯率波段機會。
他透露其獨門心法在於摒除過多市場噪音，僅專注於少數關鍵的總體經濟指標，而非過度解讀各國央行官員的發言或隨市場情緒起舞。
運用類似方法，派克也在彭博歐元兌日元預測排名中奪冠，不過他坦言，這項成績也受惠於長期對歐洲經濟抱持悲觀看法，以及一些運氣。
他表示：「從某些方面來說，歐元兌日元的預測比美元兌日元多了些運氣成分。」
他指出，歐洲大幅降息，加上經濟缺乏韌性，使他對歐元持悲觀看法。「至於美元兌日元，我認為更能依循總體經濟因素來判斷。」
帕克於1995年踏入金融市場，數十年來持續追蹤日元及其他主要貨幣。根據他的LinkedIn個人資料，他於2025年加入總部位於倫敦的TTT Moneycorp。這家外匯與支付公司也在彭博最新的歐元兌美元及美元兌瑞士法郎預測排名中居冠。
帕克表示，職涯早期的日元走勢與總體經濟關聯更密切，當時較容易預測。不過，他並不認為如今的日元特別難以預測，因為日本央行對數據的反應更加敏銳，尤其是通膨數據。
他最後強調，外匯預測的本質不在於憑空研判走勢的終點，而是精確捉摸自身觀點與市場大盤預期之間的相對落差。
paras_en: After weathering multiple financial crises and sharp exchange‑rate swings, Neil Parker, a foreign‑exchange specialist who has been deep‑rooted in the yen market for nearly 30 years, has again dropped a bombshell. According to Bloomberg's latest FX forecast rankings, the strategist with the highest accuracy in predicting USD/JPY believes that as the US‑Japan rate differential narrows, the yen could rebound strongly to 147 per dollar next year.

In a market where views are sharply divided, Parker is among the most optimistic camp. He expects the yen to climb to around 155 per dollar by year‑end and then strengthen further; Bloomberg’s previous quarter champion, by contrast, predicted the yen would slide all the way to the 170 level next year.
The core reason for the extreme split in market forecasts lies in differing judgments about the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate‑hiking path.

Parker projects the BOJ will raise its policy rate from 1.25% up to at least 2%, possibly as high as 2.25%, a tightening stance far more aggressive than mainstream market expectations; regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.
Regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.

Parker, who serves as Head of Economic and Market Strategy at foreign‑exchange and payments firm TTT Moneycorp, said, "Japan may be one of the few exceptions; the BOJ will indeed honor its commitment and adjust rates to a level consistent with inflation."

Market participants in Japan remain split on whether rising inflation will prompt the central bank to accelerate tightening. Japan’s core CPI (excluding fresh food and energy) rose 2.4% year‑over‑year in September, a key gauge the BOJ watches closely to assess underlying inflation.
Parker noted that if the increase reaches 2.6% or higher, it could push the BOJ to take stronger action and speed up tightening, though he is unsure whether the bank will act as early as December.

The divergence in tightening pace between the U.S. and Japan underpins his yen‑strength forecast. He says a further narrowing of the interest‑rate gap by about 50 basis points – the magnitude he expects around mid‑to‑late next year – could be enough to make investors revise their expectations.
He added, "Investors don’t necessarily need to increase exposure to Japanese assets; simply reducing the pace of de‑risking is sufficient."

The yen’s average rate this year has been about 158 per dollar, slipping to 163.99 in July before Japanese and U.S. authorities intervened. Market volatility tests Parker’s forecast, but unless the underlying economic fundamentals that support his view change, he is reluctant to alter his outlook.
When building his forecast model, Parker compares market expectations for rates and inflation with his own analysis, seeking price dislocations that create exchange‑rate swing opportunities.
He revealed his secret lies in filtering out excessive market noise and focusing on a handful of key macro indicators, rather than over‑interpreting central‑bank speeches or chasing market sentiment.
Using a similar approach, Parker also topped Bloomberg’s EUR/JPY forecast rankings, though he admits that result was helped by a long‑standing bearish view on Europe’s economy and a bit of luck.
He said, "In some respects, the EUR/JPY forecast involved more luck than the USD/JPY one."

He pointed out that Europe’s deep rate cuts and a lack of economic resilience have made him bearish on the euro. "As for USD/JPY, I think it can be judged more directly by macro fundamentals," he added.

Parker entered the financial markets in 1995 and has tracked the yen and other major currencies for decades. According to his LinkedIn profile, he joined London‑based TTT Moneycorp in 2025. The firm also leads Bloomberg’s latest forecast rankings for EUR/USD and USD/CHF.

Parker said his early‑career yen moves were more closely tied to macro fundamentals and therefore easier to predict. He does not think the yen is especially harder to forecast today, as the BOJ now reacts more sharply to data, especially inflation figures.

He concluded that the essence of FX forecasting is not to guess the ultimate direction out of thin air, but to precisely gauge the relative gap between one’s own view and the broader market consensus.

items.title: 高盛點名！AI股下跌首選避險貨幣標的：日元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Names AI Stock Decline Hedge: Japanese Yen
paras: 高盛最新表示，儘管近期美股回檔時，日元避險屬性表現平淡，但若AI概念股進一步走低，日元仍是最佳貨幣避險工具。
由Kamakshya Trivedi領銜的策略師在報告中指出，市場無需過度外推近期美元兌日元與科技股的弱聯動關係，仍有多項理由支撐日圓避險價值。
數據顯示，自10月初以來，在那斯達克指數表現落後標普500的交易日內，美元兌日元平均走低，上周四(5日)股市暴跌當日也不例外。美元兌日元與AI相關股票日報酬率的一個月滾動相關性，已飆升至今年以來最高水準。
根據高盛策略師分析，上周四股市重挫、隔日反彈的走勢，反映出波動主因更可能是倉位調整，而非AI產業基本面預期惡化。
他們判斷，若全球經濟前景明顯轉差，匯市波動率將攀升，日元表現有望跑贏其他主要貨幣。做空美元兌日元作為對沖工具的效果將更顯著，但前提是，基本面預期必須出現比當前更大、更廣泛的轉變。
該投行也重申，投資人不應輕忽日元的防禦性配置價值，在AI敘事持續擾動市場的環境下，日元仍是對沖科技股回檔風險的首選貨幣。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs recently said that although the yen’s hedge property has been muted during the recent pullback in U.S. equities, if AI‑related stocks fall further the yen remains the best currency hedge tool.

Strategists led by Kamakshya Trivedi noted in the report that the market need not over‑extrapolate the recent weak correlation between the dollar‑yen pair and tech stocks, as there are still many reasons to support the yen’s hedge value.

Data show that since early October, on trading days when the Nasdaq lagged the S&P 500, the dollar‑yen pair tended to weaken, and last Thursday (the 5th) when the market crashed was no exception. The one‑month rolling correlation between the dollar‑yen and daily returns of AI‑related stocks has surged to its highest level this year.

According to Goldman strategists, last Thursday’s sharp market drop and the next‑day rebound suggest that the main driver of volatility was more likely position‑adjustment rather than a deterioration in AI industry fundamentals.

They judge that if the global economic outlook clearly worsens, FX volatility will rise and the yen is likely to outperform other major currencies. Shorting the dollar‑yen as a hedge will become more effective, provided that fundamental expectations shift larger and more broadly than they do today.

The bank also reiterated that investors should not overlook the defensive value of the yen; in an environment where the AI narrative continues to stir markets, the yen remains the top currency for hedging against tech‑stock pullbacks.

據美國官方公布9月躉售庫存及躉售銷售月率增長幅度分別擴大至2.8%及0.7%，且10月就業趨勢指數升至108.36，不過據紐約聯邦儲備銀行一項調查，預計一年後失業率將上升的受訪者比例升至2020年4月以來最高，且里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金表示在考慮如何通過貨幣政策應對通脹之際應審慎調整政策，拖累美元兌日圓下滑至157.65低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.20-40，支撐於157.40-60。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特表示目前尚無充分證據人工智能(AI)已顯著提升生產率並導致大規模失業，且隨著AI相關股票反彈提振市場情緒，另外投資人對伊朗戰爭升級的擔憂有所緩解，且紐西蘭選舉結果仍難分勝負，官方結果要到11月27日才會公布，但總理拉克森領導的現任中右翼聯盟仍保持微弱多數的優勢，支撐對風險敏感的澳幣、紐元雙雙走升，連帶使得歐元兌美元自1.1135低點回升。
隨後據德國聯邦統計局公布9月經季節性調整貿易順差降至156億歐元，但其中進出口分別較前月增長4.2%、2.0%，遠高於市場預期，另外11月歐元區Sentix指數降至正2.4，印證了市場對經濟停滯的預期，但降幅不如市場預期嚴重，令歐元兌美元盤整於1.1225高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1255-75，支撐於1.1190-1.1210。
◆GBP/USD

英國招聘與就業聯合會(REC)和會計師事務所畢馬威(KPMG)週一公布的聯合月度調查顯示，10月長期員工招聘指數降至46.6，為5月以來最低水平，同時臨時員工招聘指數降至48.9，是自3月以來首次下滑，拖累英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3342低點；隨後因人工智能(AI)相關擔憂有所緩解，且美國總統川普淡化了再次對伊朗發動襲擊的可能性，隨著油價下跌，推漲英鎊兌美元回漲至1.3442高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3475-95，支撐於1.3405-25。

U.S. October employment growth accelerated, with the unemployment rate falling to 4.1%. The closely watched jobs report also showed that August and September added a combined 84,000 jobs, upward revisions from earlier estimates. This extra labor may help absorb cost‑of‑living pressure caused by the Middle‑East conflict, and as the labor market regains momentum after a mid‑year slowdown, it boosts the odds that the Federal Reserve will raise rates in December. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees about an 80% probability of a Fed hike next month, supporting the dollar. In addition, Japan’s Ministry of Finance released quarterly data showing that Japanese authorities carried out a record‑size one‑day yen‑buying intervention from July 30 to August 3, with the July 30 operation alone reaching ¥7.98 trillion – the largest single‑day intervention since data began in 1991. By the end of October Japan’s foreign‑exchange reserves had risen to $1.179 trillion. However, the widening U.S.–Japan bond spread and expectations of further Fed tightening have kept the dollar/yen range around the 158.53 high.

U.S. official data showed September wholesale inventories and sales grew 2.8% and 0.7% month‑over‑month, and the October Employment Trend Index rose to 108.36. Yet a New York Fed survey found the share of respondents expecting higher unemployment a year from now had risen to its highest level since April 2020, and Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin warned that policy adjustments should be made cautiously as the Fed considers how to tackle inflation. This weighed on the dollar, pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 157.65. The dollar is seen facing resistance at 158.20‑40 and support at 157.40‑60 today.
EUR/USD

RBA Deputy Governor Hunt said there is still no solid evidence that artificial intelligence has significantly boosted productivity or caused large‑scale job losses. With AI‑related stocks rallying and market sentiment improving, and with concerns over an escalation of the Iran conflict easing, the New Zealand election remains too close to call – the official result won’t be released until November 27, though Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s centre‑right coalition still holds a slim majority. These factors have supported risk‑sensitive currencies, lifting both the Australian and New Zealand dollars and helping the euro recover from its 1.1135 low against the dollar.

German Federal Statistics Office data showed September’s seasonally adjusted trade surplus fell to €15.6 billion, but both exports and imports rose 4.2% and 2.0% month‑over‑month, far above market expectations. The Euro‑zone Sentix index for November slipped to +2.4, confirming expectations of a stagnant economy, though the decline was milder than feared. The euro therefore steadied around the 1.1225 high against the dollar. Resistance for EUR/USD is estimated at 1.1255‑75 with support at 1.1190‑1.1210 today.
GBP/USD

A joint monthly survey by the Recruitment and Employment Confederation (REC) and accounting firm KPMG released on Monday showed the October long‑term hiring index fell to 46.6, the lowest since May, while the temporary hiring index dropped to 48.9 – the first decline since March. This pulled the pound down to a low of 1.3342 against the dollar. However, as AI‑related worries eased and former President Trump downplayed the likelihood of another attack on Iran, oil prices fell and the pound rebounded to a high of 1.3442. Resistance for GBP/USD is seen at 1.3475‑95 with support at 1.3405‑25 today.
